release.raw_body:
# Quiet.md 0.1.14

## 中文

这次更新带来正则查找、Obsidian 双链跳转、可下载的文档字体、土耳其语界面和从右往左的阿拉伯语排版，也让大文档库里的搜索和删除快了很多。

- **正则查找**：查找替换栏里点 `.*` 就按正则表达式匹配（不区分大小写，在一行内匹配），替换时可以用 `$1`、`${name}` 引用分组，替换后保留原来的文字样式；写错的表达式会提示「正则有误」。
- **Obsidian 双链**：导入的 Obsidian 库里，`[[笔记]]`、`[[文件夹/笔记]]`、`[[笔记#标题]]` 这样的双链点一下就打开对应的笔记，规则和 Obsidian 一致（不区分大小写、路径可省、同一文件夹优先）。
- **新语言和从右往左排版**：新增土耳其语界面，界面语言一共 9 种。阿拉伯语正确连写；从右往左的段落靠右排，光标、选区和方向键都按从右往左走，列表符号在右侧。
- **字体**：设置 › 外观里可以分别选择界面字体和文档字体，代码块仍用主题的等宽字体。字体列表按黑体、宋体、楷体·手写、等宽、西文等分组，每行用自己的字体显示示例，悬停或用方向键移到某一行就预览整页效果，可以收藏，也会记住最近用过的。
- **按需下载字体**：文档字体可以选霞鹜文楷、朱雀仿宋和小赖手写体，选中时才从 download.quiet.md 下载，列表里显示大小和下载进度，下载的字体可以删除。画板的中日韩手写字体（Xiaolai，14 MB）不再打包进安装包，第一次需要时才下载，下载期间画板先用系统字体。字体文件按哈希校验，除了请求这个文件不发送任何信息。
- **清理未使用资源**：设置 › 文档库可以找出没有任何笔记（包括回收站、版本历史和本机文件）用到的图片和文件，确认后移到文档库的 `.quiet/removed-assets`，30 天后自动删除，期间可以拖回来。
- **退格键回到标题**：设置 › 通用里新增这个开关，默认开（和以前一样，在正文开头按退格会把第一段并入标题）；关掉后光标留在正文里。
- **快捷键变化**：Windows 和 Linux 上「复制为 Markdown」的默认快捷键改为 **Ctrl+Shift+M**（原来的 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C 在不少键盘布局上会被当成 AltGr 打出字母）。macOS 仍是 ⌘⇧C。自己改过键位的不受影响。
- **更快**：两千篇文档的库里，搜索框每输入一个字从最慢 5 秒多降到 45 毫秒以内；删除 190 篇的文件夹从最慢 1.5 秒降到约 0.1 秒，全选删除 822 项从约 1.1 秒降到约 0.23 秒，清空回收站从约 1 秒降到约 0.08 秒。切换文档时不再每次都同步写盘。
- **窗口和画板**：窗口变窄时自动收起的侧栏，放宽后会自动展开（手动收起的不会）。画板支持触控板双指缩放。笔记和侧栏之间的阴影更淡了。
- **文档菜单**：「…」菜单去掉了「更多」子菜单，「复制为 Markdown」直接放在「下载为」后面；「阅读模式」和「显示引用列表」变成菜单里的开关。
- **修复**：切换文档卡顿；代码块的折叠状态随文档保存；画板选背景色时可能崩溃；深色模式下查找替换和设置弹窗里的按钮看不清；Windows 上的设置说明和首次启动引导不再写 ⌘N 和「访达」；繁体中文界面用词统一（文件庫、垃圾桶）。

数据表这个版本还不开放：新建不了数据表，已有的数据表文件只显示只读占位，文件保持原样。

## English

This update brings regular-expression find, Obsidian wikilinks, downloadable document fonts, a Turkish interface and right-to-left Arabic, and makes search and deleting much faster in large libraries.

- **Regular expressions**: click `.*` in the find bar to match a regular expression (case-insensitive, within one line). Replacements can use `$1` and `${name}` groups and keep the replaced text's style; an invalid pattern says so.
- **Obsidian wikilinks**: in an imported Obsidian vault, links such as `[[Note]]`, `[[Folder/Note]]` and `[[Note#Heading]]` open the note they point to, resolved the way Obsidian does (case-insensitive, path optional, same folder first).
- **New language, right to left**: a Turkish interface, for nine interface languages in all. Arabic joins its letters; right-to-left paragraphs are right-aligned, and the caret, selection and arrow keys move right to left, with list markers on the right.
- **Fonts**: choose the interface font and the document font separately in Setti

release.raw_body:
Since the beta of AdGuard Home v1.0 was released in late September, we collected feedback and acted accordingly. The product has gone through major overhaul both under the hood and appearance-wise in the beta versions. The stable release adds the fine-tuning that users asked for. Today, we are releasing AdGuard Home v1.0.

## A redesign you don’t have to relearn

The web interface for AdGuard Home has been completely updated to look cleaner, more modern, and fully aligned with the rest of the AdGuard ecosystem. Avoiding overall layout changes was intentional — we didn’t wish for you to stress out while relearning where every button is. We refreshed the visual style while preserving the familiar logic. We wrote extensively about it in our [article on the beta version](https://adguard-dns.io/en/blog/adguard-home-v1-0-beta.html), it is worth a look if you need more information. 

![New dashboard](https://cdn.adtidy.org/content/release_notes/dns/home-v1-0-beta/dashboard.png)

But this overhaul goes deeper than looks. The new frontend shares the backend’s strict optimization philosophy. Rebuilt with fine-grained reactivity, it is now significantly lighter and faster. This update also resolves memory consumption issues linked to the old interface, making AdGuard Home run smoothly on low-power devices, and introduces a fully responsive mobile UI.

![Before and after](https://cdn.adtidy.org/content/release_notes/dns/home-v1-0-beta/adguard_home_before_after.png)

## New release model

We are adopting a more flexible development and versioning model used by other AdGuard products. Minor releases may now include backward-incompatible changes, which lets us ship features faster.

What does this mean for you? Moving forward, the new release cycle will focus on delivering features and tools, not just patches and library updates.

No migration needed: v1.0 keeps the same configuration schema as v0.107.x, , so your existing configuration works as is.

## What changed since the beta

While the first beta of v1.0 introduced a globally changed interface, the second beta was all about stability. 18 changes were included in it, we will highlight the most important ones below; you can consult the full list in the [changelog](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/releases/tag/v1.0.0-b.2).

* **DHCP:** IPv4 settings can now be saved alongside an IPv6-compatible interface, DHCP starts with a DHCPv6-only configuration, and subnet validation works as exp

release.summary_zh:
- Windows 11 x64、DirectX 12。选 Veyra 实际使用的 GPU 的包。安装器可选择路径和桌面快捷方式，开始菜单和 Windows「已安装的应用」提供卸载入口。便携版解压到新建的可写目录，运行根目录的 **Veyra.exe**。
- 从旧便携版升级时，关闭旧版后按需复制 `runtime_local/user-data-2.0.0` 和 `runtime_local/luts` 到新目录的 `runtime_local`。同分版安装器可在原路径覆盖安装。已装 2.2.0 测试版的用户请用本页正式安装器覆盖一次，以取得内置发行公钥。
- 「设置 → 关于 → 检查更新」支持验证并下载之后的稳定版，正常退出后应用，启动失败时可回退。下载线路可选 GitHub、GH-Proxy 和 GHFast。镜像失败时重试直连，更新清单使用 Ed25519 签名，程序另外核对 ZIP 的包型、大小和 SHA-256。
release.raw_body:
Windows 安装器、实时字幕翻译、虚拟摄像机、全屏缩放，以及从 2.1.9 以来的采集、串流、录制和导出修复。

## 下载与升级 / Download and upgrade

| Veyra 使用的显卡 / GPU | 安装器 / Setup | 便携版 / Portable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NVIDIA | [NVIDIA Setup EXE](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/releases/download/v2.2.0/Veyra-2.2.0-NVIDIA-win64-setup.exe) | [NVIDIA ZIP](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/releases/download/v2.2.0/Veyra-2.2.0-NVIDIA-win64-portable.zip) |
| AMD | [AMD Setup EXE](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/releases/download/v2.2.0/Veyra-2.2.0-AMD-win64-setup.exe) | [AMD ZIP](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/releases/download/v2.2.0/Veyra-2.2.0-AMD-win64-portable.zip) |

- Windows 11 x64、DirectX 12。选 Veyra 实际使用的 GPU 的包。安装器可选择路径和桌面快捷方式，开始菜单和 Windows「已安装的应用」提供卸载入口。便携版解压到新建的可写目录，运行根目录的 **Veyra.exe**。
- 从旧便携版升级时，关闭旧版后按需复制 `runtime_local/user-data-2.0.0` 和 `runtime_local/luts` 到新目录的 `runtime_local`。同分版安装器可在原路径覆盖安装。已装 2.2.0 测试版的用户请用本页正式安装器覆盖一次，以取得内置发行公钥。
- 「设置 → 关于 → 检查更新」支持验证并下载之后的稳定版，正常退出后应用，启动失败时可回退。下载线路可选 GitHub、GH-Proxy 和 GHFast。镜像失败时重试直连，更新清单使用 Ed25519 签名，程序另外核对 ZIP 的包型、大小和 SHA-256。
- 这次 Windows 安装器尚未做 Authenticode 发布者签名。可按 [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/releases/download/v2.2.0/SHA256SUMS.txt) 核对下载文件。

Use the package for the GPU selected by Veyra. Run Setup or extract the portable ZIP into a writable folder and run **Veyra.exe**. To carry settings forward from the old portable layout, copy the data and LUT folders above after closing Veyra. Settings → About offers signed updates for subsequent releases. The Windows installer is Authenticode-unsigned. See the checksums above.

## 完整更新

### 显示、画质与补帧

- 全来源和大图预览启用精细送显缩放。放大使用有界三次插值，缩小时按比例扩大取样范围，减少细线和 HUD 的锯齿及闪烁。原始像素的对齐 1:1 路径保持逐像素输出，HDR 高光旁做防振铃处理。可在「专业模式 → 显示」切换画面比例对照。
- 支持选用 HUD 自动锁定、帧节奏修复和自适应补帧倍率。HUD 锁定适用于图内生成帧，XeSS 的内部呈现路径独立。自适应倍率以所选倍率为上限，使用内容帧率和显示目标调整。修复自动倍率在去重测量完成之前过早降档、输出上限计算及 RTX 30 的 CUDA 缓存问题。
- 自动去重按实际内容帧节奏工作，改善变节拍输入。60→30 下低于 30 FPS 时跳过可确认的重复画面，保留原时间戳；2X 生成帧的等待按实际刷新周期调度，给原帧留出呈现窗口。参见 [#156](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/pull/156) 和 [#126](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/issues/126)。
- 修正部分 FSR 初始化失败及 XeSS 重建资源的稳定性，并处理 Ada VFG 中档的异步失败和等待释放。原报告的显卡与驱动组合仍需复测。参见 [#164](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/issues/164)、[#169](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/issues/169)、[#145](https://github.com/Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo/issues/145)。
- 修复 PS5 SDR 暗部压暗。SDR 保留码值，HDR 请求回退到 8 位时按 SDR 处理，10 位 PQ 继续走 HDR。恢复 HDR10 静态元数据的发送和清除。HDR 曲线忽略不可信的自动峰值报告，手动峰值优先。参见 [#59](https://github.com

release.raw_body:
**On a Mac?** The `-experimental` files are fresh builds for Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel) that we haven't tried ourselves yet. Want to be among the first? Give them a go and tell us how it went in an [issue](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues).

A big fixes release: YouTube and video downloads, crashes and freezes, downloads on slow disks, the Mac helper, plus a Safari extension, far more file types and a few new columns and options.

### Added

- **Torrent → Files…**: the list of a torrent's files for any torrent, running, stopped or finished, with a box to choose each (also a Files… button in File Properties).
- **Two columns for torrents in the download list** ([#357](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/357)): **Peers** (those a torrent has connected while it runs, seeders and leechers alike) and **Share ratio** (what it has sent against what it took), after **Transfer rate**. A layout saved before them gets them there.
- The extension's **Media on this page** can name a file after its page: **Prefix media file names with the page title** puts the page's title before the file's own name. Off as installed.
- **Far more file types taken from the browser by default** ([#382](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/382)): AI models and datasets (GGUF, SAFETENSORS, CKPT, PT, ONNX, PARQUET...), 3D and CAD (GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, BLEND, STEP...), design and camera RAW files, ebooks, Office files, DAT, disk images and split archives. A list you never edited gains them; one you edited stays yours.
- **A Safari extension, inside the Mac app:** a click on a link to a file type MDM takes goes to MDM, and so do the right-click items, the button over videos and **Media on this page**, as in the other browsers. Safari gives extensions no access to its downloads, so a download a page starts by itself stays with Safari, and the browser's proxy is not shared. See [Browser integration](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/blob/v0.5.2/docs/browser-integration.md#safari-macos).
- Help: what to do when an antivirus or VirusTotal flags MDM, and how to check your copy is the real one.

### Changed

- In English, the **Last Try Date** and **Added** columns follow the system's 12- or 24-hour clock: `Oct 28 9:44:12 PM 2026` when Windows uses a 12-hour clock, and **Added** starts wide enough for it ([#392](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/392)).

### Fixed

- With no tray icon to co

release.summary_zh:
- **使用 Tether 自带您自己的计算机。** Tether 将您自己的计算机变成 Open WebUI 的一部分：来自 Ollama、LM Studio 或任何 OpenAI 兼容服务器的模型、您在 Tether 应用程序中添加的 OpenAPI 和 MCP 工具服务器以及开放终端服务器现在仅显示在模型选择器中、+ 菜单的工具列表以及您连接的任何 Open WebUI 的终端菜单中，无论您在什么设备上打开它，并且 Open WebUI 通过 Tether 访问它们，因此它们的地址、命令和密钥永远不会离开你的电脑。这需要 Tether 0.1.14 或更高版本，或者 MCP 服务器需要 0.1.16，工具服务器和终端需要打开“ENABLE_TOOL_SERVERS”，并且 ID 与 Open WebUI 中已有模型匹配的 Tether 模型保持隐藏。 Tether 取代了直接连接。 [#34397](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues/34397)

release.raw_body:
### Added

- **Bring your own computer with Tether.** Tether turns your own computer into part of Open WebUI: models from Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server, OpenAPI and MCP tool servers and Open Terminal servers that you add in the Tether app now show up just for you in the model selector, the Tools list of the + menu and the terminal menu of any Open WebUI you connect, from whatever device you open it on, and Open WebUI reaches them through Tether, so their addresses, commands and keys never leave your computer. This needs Tether 0.1.14 or later, or 0.1.16 for MCP servers, tool servers and terminals need "ENABLE_TOOL_SERVERS" turned on, and a Tether model whose ID matches a model already in Open WebUI stays hidden. Tether replaces Direct Connections. [#34397](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues/34397)
- **Sandboxed agents on your own computer.** Tether 0.1.13 or later can lock the terminal on your computer into a sandbox, so models and coding agents work in your real files without reaching the rest of your machine: on macOS and supported Windows devices, Open Terminal and everything it launches, coding agents included, can only touch the one folder you pick, run offline unless you turn on Network access and accept no incoming connections, with no Docker, virtual machine or administrator setup needed. If the sandbox cannot be enforced, the terminal stays stopped instead of quietly running without it, and browser and desktop control stay off while it is on. Turn it on in Tether under Settings > Open Terminal > Sandbox.
- **Local MCP servers through Tether.** Open WebUI can now use MCP servers that run as a local command over stdio, the way many MCP servers are distributed, by launching them on your computer through Tether 0.1.16 or later, with no proxy such as mcpo and no port to open. Add one in Tether under Settings > Integrations > Tools with its command, or connect an MCP server by its web address, and pick it from the Tools list of the + menu. Local commands run with your own account's access, outside Tether's workspace sandbox.
- **A computer for every user.** With Terminals 0.4.0 or later connected, Open WebUI now hands out sandboxed computers on demand: anyone with Write access to the connection can create a terminal right from the terminal menu of the message input, pick whether everyone shares one machine or each user, chat or model gets its own, and set its image, CPU, memory, storage, network profile, environment var

## Upgrade notice

### Database formats

- **Primary-key rich text (formats 15 and 16).** Inline rich text saved in format 15 by earlier preview builds remains readable. Saving new block rich text in a primary key, including text with images, upgrades the database to at least format 16. [Primary-key compatibility](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/21136)
- **Inline images in ordinary text fields (format 17).** Saving the first inline image in an ordinary text field upgrades that database to format 17. [Text field compatibility](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/21527)

Simply opening a database does not trigger these upgrades. Version 3.8.10 supports database formats up to 14. A client can only open databases in formats it supports. Update every device that syncs or accesses the same data before using the new formats. Back up your workspace beforehand. To roll back, restore a complete pre-upgrade snapshot.

### Other compatibility changes

- **AI long-term memory.** Restoring a workspace snapshot now rolls back both memory records and their revocation state. Restoring a snapshot from before a memory was forgotten can make it available again if it still passes the usual validity checks. [Long-term memory](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/blob/64fe75eb55fc783a345ea00fb4db8b60268dd65c/docs/LONG-TERM-MEMORY.md)
- **Kernel API.** JSON requests handled by API contracts have a 32 MiB body limit, with a 64 KiB limit for `loginAuth`. Requests exceeding these limits return code `-1`. [API contracts](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/blob/64fe75eb55fc783a345ea00fb4db8b60268dd65c/docs/API-CONTRACTS.md)

## Overview

This release adds rich text and block editing in database primary keys, a built-in date picker, unified color editing, and plugin snapshot browsing and restoration.

Mind maps support custom node and connector styles and freeform connections between nodes. The standalone Markdown editor adds find and replace, while macOS gains offline Markdown Quick Look previews.

Watch the release overview: [YouTube](https://youtu.be/PLbCKqtZw_M)

OpenFilm 0.4.1 makes timeline previews more responsive, adds export for a marked range, and makes it easier to continue work after an interruption.

## Highlights

- **Faster timeline previews.** Scrub through available frames and release to give the chosen position priority. Studio can show a cached frame while a chapter opens, preloads upcoming pages during playback, and keeps the previous picture visible while the preview catches up. The loading message over the picture is gone.
- **Export a timeline range.** Set the in and out points with `I` and `O` or the Time Range menu. Open Export with `⌘M` on macOS or `Ctrl+M` on Windows to export the marked range.
- **Continue an interrupted task.** Stop a task and resume it in the same conversation using the model and reasoning effort selected in the composer. If you switch agents, the new agent gets the original request and saved progress.
- **Smoother editing.** Drag a clip over the middle of another to preview a replacement or near an edge to insert it. Linked clips follow the main track as it moves, and selecting a marker previews its frame before playback starts there.

Thanks to everyone who sent reports and pull requests. Thanks especially to @hobostay for the fix that prevents Studio from getting stuck while trimming edit history. [#505](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/505)

## Install or update

Run `npx -y openfilm@latest` for the CLI, or download the desktop installer from Assets below. Existing desktop installations can update from the app.

## Desktop app

- OpenFilm and own-key agents can retry interrupted model requests from the last completed tool result. When a request still fails, connection details show the failed stage, elapsed time, retry count, and available error code or request ID.
- The chat stays in place as working status, commands, and replies arrive. Click the conversation title for history or to start a new chat. The attachment menu has more space above the composer.
- Studio can reconnect after a failed restart and copy local diagnostics while disconnected.
- On Windows, closing during an agent task, export, or media generation minimizes the window so the work can finish. Updates and uninstalls protect projects and personal media stored in the install directory.
- Storage settings move your personal asset library with the projects folder, including across drives. Studio can recover the project list when its local index is damaged.

AgentRun observation CLI 0.1.10 with the Node launcher @parcha/agentrun-cli 0.1.1.

Connect selected Claude Code and Codex sessions to an AgentRun workspace using device authentication or an explicitly configured enrollment credential. Observation reports activity; it does not execute or control agents. Session selection, metadata consent, and login startup remain explicit choices.

## Installation

Verified platform: Linux x64 with glibc, Node.js 20 or newer. The launcher provisions Python 3.12, verifies release checksums, and installs a persistent runtime outside the npm cache. macOS, Windows, and other architectures are not supported by this launcher release.

The npm launcher is published as `@parcha/agentrun-cli@0.1.1`:

```sh
npx --yes @parcha/agentrun-cli@0.1.1 --help
```

The GitHub-hosted package also works directly:

```sh
npx --yes --package https://github.com/Parcha-ai/agentrun/releases/download/cli-v0.1.10/parcha-agentrun-cli-0.1.1.tgz agentrun --help
```

For enrollment, use `connect --device-auth --origin <your-api-origin> --workspace-id <your-workspace-id>`. Keep any selected `--state-dir` on subsequent commands. Device approval uses a browser on any device and requires no local callback server.

## Release integrity and source

`release.json` names each runtime artifact and its SHA-256. The launcher accepts only this repository's pinned CLI release URLs and one HTTPS redirect to GitHub's exact release-assets.githubusercontent.com host. Explicit preview download sources retain their no-redirect policy.

The `agentrun-cli-source-0.1.10.tar.gz` asset contains the exact build inputs for these artifacts. Extract it and run `python3.12 scripts/agentrun/build_cli_release.py --output /tmp/agentrun-release-rebuild` with Node/npm available. All release files were rebuilt byte-for-byte from this source snapshot. The repository tag identifies the release location; use the attached source snapshot to reproduce the CLI assets.

45 launcher process/HTTP/HTTPS tests passed. release.raw_body:
# Cage v0.1.8

这是 v0.1.8 正式版，包含 v0.1.7 之后合入主线的改动，提供 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Android 安装包。

## 主要改动

- 工作台底部时钟可在“设置 → 通用”切换 12/24 小时制，保存后立即生效，并在重新打开时保留选择。
- 降低原生环境轮询与画面传输开销，优化空闲内存回收。Windows 浏览器画面跟随查看设备的屏幕像素密度，保留清晰度和输入位置的一致性。
- 桌面应用更新支持中断续传和重试，以无数据传输的时长判断停滞。Windows 更新支持可信发布者证书续期；Linux 发现新版时提供发行页入口，仍通过系统包手动安装。
- Android 增加设置页检查更新及下载、校验和系统安装入口。旧 APK 没有“检查更新”时，需要先从官网下载新版并覆盖安装一次。
- 完善 macOS 物理出口网卡筛选、IPv6 安全检查和浏览器硬件渲染参数。图形加速是否生效仍由系统、驱动和 Chromium 决定。
- 同步主线中的项目与账户操作、登录回跳、代理恢复、macOS 屏幕共享入口和 Windows SSH 远程环境改进。

- 通过 Agent CLI 选择单节点出口时，会清除原多跳链；选择已在链中的节点也能正常完成。需要多跳时继续使用链式代理设置。
- Linux 基础软件包安装失败时，显示失败命令、涉及的软件包及已脱敏的输出末尾，帮助区分 DNS、连接和软件源问题。该改进提供排查证据，不能保证网络或软件源故障自动恢复。
- 修复手动 Windows ISO 安装时应答文件被安装程序忽略的问题，保留磁盘、版本等手动安装选择。
- 补充 Windows 客机官方 Desktop 无法打开共享项目时的处理说明：共享项目通过终端使用，Desktop 可选择客机本地目录；该说明未增加 Desktop 的共享目录支持。

## 安装与更新

macOS 安装包面向 Apple Silicon，Windows 安装器面向 x64，Linux 提供 x86_64 DEB，Android 提供 arm64 APK。Intel Mac 的实验源码与 CI 构建已合入，当前公开安装包不包含 Intel Mac 发行物。

桌面端手动覆盖安装前，请保存工作、停止环境并退出 Cage。使用 macOS 或 Windows 应用内更新时，请保存工作后点击更新按钮；校验通过后，应用会自动停止环境、安装并重启。账户、配置、项目、登录凭据与持久磁盘保留。Windows v0.1.7 用户需先按[维护指南](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/blob/main/docs/guide/maintenance.md)使用完整安装器手动升级一次。Android 覆盖安装沿用既有签名身份；iOS 继续采用本地 Xcode 构建方式。

## 验证范围

本版本功能改动已通过 macOS、Windows 和 Linux CI。发行包的签名、macOS 公证、摘要及公开下载校验结果记录在[对应的 GitHub Release](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases/tag/v0.1.8)。本机已完成组合代码的 Go 全量与竞态测试、前端单测和构建、实际 Chromium 画面与密度测试、时钟交互、隔离 CLI、macOS 更新回滚及安装/重装/卸载数据保留测试。

本次发布未完成全部原生界面的实机验收。托管 CI、容器及模拟器结果不代表真实 Windows Hyper-V、Linux KVM、Intel Mac 客机、Android 物理设备或 Claude 授权与模型请求已经验收。

发行物均来自源码提交 `9a35a1452cc893525a7fcf50da172d83bc4c4a81`，包含 #293–#296。macOS App 与 DMG 完成 Developer ID 签名、Apple 公证及 Gatekeeper 验证；Android 沿用既有签名并使用 versionCode 6，从 rc.1 覆盖升级保留设备指纹、主题与首次安装时间。

[发行候选 CI](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/actions/runs/43784149153) · [Windows/Linux 签名构建](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/actions/runs/43784147530)

发行候选的完整 CI 与 Windows/Linux 签名构建已通过。Windows 安装器完成可信 Authenticode 签名及云端安装验收，Linux 系统包完成 Debian/Ubuntu 兼容性验收。四个平台的安装包与对应源码共 10 个文件均已通过统一 SHA-256 清单校验。

[公开下载验收与官网部署](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/actions/runs/43788079674)已全部通过：匿名下载四平台安装包核对 SHA-256，重新验证公开 macOS 安装包的签名、公证、Gatekeeper 及对应源码，并完成[官网](https://claude-cage.com/)部署。

release.raw_body:
# Grok Bot Anywhere 0.1.5 更新说明

状态：Current。发布日期：2026-11-13。

0.1.5 是一次结构性更新：GBA 开始支持多个 Grok Bot 账号；微信分享菜单增加「保存到本地」；CLI 改为通过本机 API 复用 GBA 多账号，旧的静态凭据 CLI 已被替换。

## 下载

| 平台 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Apple Silicon（M1–M4） | `Grok Bot Anywhere-0.1.5-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `Grok Bot Anywhere-0.1.5.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `Grok Bot Anywhere-0.1.5-win.zip` |

macOS 两个 DMG 由 CI 做 Developer ID 签名、公证和 stapler。Windows zip 仍未签名；SmartScreen/SAC 可能拦截，需要自行解除锁定或用你的证书签名。

## 多账号

- 设置 → 常规 支持添加多个 Grok Bot 账号，每个账号可勾选/取消勾选。
- 勾选账号的 Bot 会合并到主界面侧栏；多个勾选账号时先按账号分组，再在账号内应用原来的「分组模式」。
- 只有一个勾选账号时保持原来的单账号结构，不显示账号头。
- 每个账号的凭据单独加密保存在 `accounts/<id>.enc`；旧单账号 `account.enc` 会在首次成功连接后迁移。
- 分享菜单、收件箱、通知、Explorer 菜单、原生伴侣、深链和发送路由都带账号作用域；单个账号断开或移除不会影响其他账号。
- 同名 Bot/分组按账号隔离，不再跨账号互相隐藏。

## 微信「保存到本地」

- 设置 → 分享菜单新增「保存到本地」开关。
- 开启后微信分享菜单多一项「保存到本地」；支持默认位置或每次打开目录选择器，选择器默认从上次目录开始。
- 单文件直接保存，多文件放进时间戳子目录，纯文字存 `.txt`，同名文件自动加序号，不覆盖。
- 只对微信转发生效；不创建 receipt、不进入发送记录、不投递 Bot。
- 开启保存后 Bot 菜单槽上限为 11，保存项占第 12 行。
- 受 macOS 分享扩展限制，Finder 里也可能出现该入口；从 Finder 点击会被拒绝。该限制需要在后续版本用前台 App 动态启停进一步收紧。

## CLI 与本地 API

- 新增本地 API：主进程监听本机 socket，CLI 通过 `userData/local-api.token` 鉴权，不保存明文凭据。
- 新增 `gba` 命令行；`grok-bot` 现在是 `gba` 的别名，旧的 0.3.0 静态 CLI 与 `profiles/default.json` 已移除。
- 当前开放 38 个方法：账号、Bot、recipient、收件、发送/等待、runtime、分享菜单、设置等；详见 `docs/subsystems/local-api.md`。
- Skill 仅保留 gba 内容；Agent 调用时使用 `gba` 或 `grok-bot`，并始终加 `--json`。
- 交互式 zsh 里 `gba` 可能被 Git 别名 `git branch --all` 抢占；用 `grok-bot` 或 `command gba`。

## 修复

- 修复窗口销毁后残留 IPC 调用访问已销毁 `webContents` 导致的 `Object has been destroyed`。
- 修复多账号同名分组/Bot 的跨账号去重问题。
- 分享菜单配置升级到 v2，宿主布局升级到 v5。

## 验证

- desktop 191 passed；client-protocol 61 passed；`npm run docs:check` 通过；`npm run smoke` 通过。
- 本地 API 在 preview 构建上实测了账号、Bot、收件、设置和 `gba` 命令。
- macOS 签名/公证、Windows 安装包和真实微信/Finder 由本次 CI 与人工验收补充。

## 已知范围

- 真实微信/Finder 中的「保存到本地」菜单位置、来源判断和默认目录 TCC 行为尚未实机验证。
- 真实双账号的发送、分享和收件链路尚未实机验证。
- Windows named pipe、Windows 安装包和 Swift 完整测试未随这一版重新验收。
- 本版本未包含 MCP；CLI/Skill 是当前 Agent 接口。

release.summary_zh:
- **更新**：修复了下载的更新在重新启动后未卸载后每次都会失败并显示“下载的文件未通过验证”的 macOS 更新。现在更新下载首先尝试 GitHub Releases，然后回退到 baocut.com 镜像。陷入该错误的 BaoCut 副本可以通过重试更新到此版本。 [更新程序修复](https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/commit/5449a1870add75351a33f14ee76bca5996716d0f)，[GitHub-first提要](https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/commit/0516df8e7c3597c5fb202c6b5e9a68ec66a22f24)
- **macOS 上的链接导入**：托管 yt-dlp 现在使用解压版本，因此在首次启动后，它会在不到一秒的时间内启动，而不是每次超过 2 秒。超时的工具检查会重试一次，并且在工具不变的情况下重复使用通过的检查，因此缓慢启动不再将 yt-dlp 标记为不可用。 [问题](https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/issues/142), [探测重试](https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/commit/f4d2f6777f168c8698707e404798c6e5a7c1e93d), [解压构建](https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/commit/57e37b338c5ac343a398239470cca90381cb7b47)
- **Codex 和 Pi**：不再删除包含 Unicode 行或段落分隔符的回复，并且输出行超过 64 MB 的进程会因说明原因而停止。中断已完成的 Codex 轮次会报告其未运行。 [输出阅读器](https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/commit/aabaf5fa7b503a5318f29492b1d0d7751efa17f0)，[Codex中断](https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/commit/83968cf62d9beca508dd7860fffe2323ab82ff9a)
release.raw_body:
## What's new in BaoCut 3.20.1

### Fixes

- **Updates**: Fixed a macOS update that failed every time with "The downloaded file didn't pass verification" after a downloaded update was left uninstalled across a restart. Update downloads now try GitHub Releases first and fall back to the baocut.com mirror. Copies of BaoCut stuck on that error can update to this version with Try again. release.raw_body:
## What's new in 0.1.176

### Updates and announcements
- **A blue update button.** In Simple mode, a round blue button appears right after Connect apps while an update downloads or is ready. Click it to restart into the new version. It disappears once you're updated.
- **What each update brought.** Announcements now lists every release, newest first. Each card says what that update brought, and "See all changes" shows the full list.

### Bots and work
- **Check before done (per bot, off by default).** Turn it on, and a bot's answer is checked by another bot before it reaches you.
- **A writer and a checker.** New ready-made bots in Templates → Writing: Nib edits only what you asked, and Vera checks the result against your document.
- **What changed.** When a bot edits a document you gave it, you can see exactly what changed, sentence by sentence. The bot can check its own changes instead of describing them from memory.
- **Saved tool approvals.** "Always allow" is now remembered for an exact tool from a connected app or MCP server. It is never remembered for anything that sends, posts or moves money, or for phone, shared-computer or this-computer control.
- **New conversations a bot opens** take the approval level of the chat that opened them.
- **Grok bots** use fewer processes per session, recover from the out-of-threads crash, resume faster after an idle close, and switch model and effort in place.
- **Routines on Starter** wake their paused bot instead of failing.

### Voice
- **Free dictation on Windows** uses Windows' built-in speech recognition. No download and no outside service.
- **⌘D (Ctrl+D on Windows and Linux)** turns dictation on and off while you're typing a message.
- **Spoken replies start sooner:** the next sentence is prepared while the current one plays.
- **Chatterbox** lists its own voices.

### Browser
- **Your clicks, keys and dropdown picks reach the page** in a bot's browser view on the default engine, and a dropped press no longer blocks the ones after it.
- **A bot no longer reports success when an action failed** in the browser.
- **Lighter browsers:** fewer processes per bot browser, and unused browsers close first when memory runs low.
- **A sign-in card's Open** wakes a browser that went to sleep.

### Cloud and computers
- **Clearer Cloud messages:** the app says when a turn can't run commands, and that moving to another computer keeps your files.
- **A routine refused the lent computer** now ends as failed and says why.

release.raw_body:
# ReelTerminal 1.5.0

## 时间线与声音

- CLI 可在一次编辑中调整多个相邻片段，按最终布局检查重叠；被拒绝的批次不会保留部分编辑。
- `timeline.retimeByAnchors` 按明确的源时间与时间线锚点生成分段或速度曲线，适合将画面节点对齐音乐。转场可选择严格检查源余量，或明确允许借用片段内容并移动后续片段。
- `audio.process.remix` 将音乐重组为指定时长，支持节拍、小节范围、尾奏和响度参数；完成后通过 `audio.process.register` 明确注册，不自动替换时间线音频。重混是节拍拼接，不保证适合任意音乐；使用前请试听。
- Ducking 可在最后一段声音结束后抬升背景音乐并淡出，包括零时长抬升。

## 动画、导入与交付

- `media.render_html` 可逐帧生成本地 HTML/CSS/SVG 动画：支持 CSS 动画、SMIL 及时间/进度变量。透明视频使用 WebM；MP4 不保留透明通道。页面脚本和外部网络资源仍不开放。
- 透明 WebM 在预览、静帧和导出中保留底层画面；生成的 WebM 同时固定 SDR BT.709 像素转换和色彩标记，减少解码路径间的颜色偏差。
- SVG 描边支持路径起点、终点与周期偏移关键帧，用于路径生长或擦除。
- `export.start` 可为 MP4 附加 PNG/JPEG 封面，并输出 SRT 字幕与章节文本。字幕与章节使用本次导出开始时的工程内容，不会混入之后的编辑；已有附件路径不会被静默覆盖。
- 桌面 CLI 的本地媒体导入上限提高至 8 GiB，大文件从本地路径流式复制。源文件在复制中改变时拒绝发布不完整副本。大小上限不保证任意编码可解码或流畅编辑。
- CLI 的复杂 JSON 推荐使用 `--stdin` 或 `--file`，减少 PowerShell/cmd 引号改写问题。

以上新增结构化操作通过 CLI 提供；使用应用的启动提示连接助手，再按共享命令帮助发现参数。写入仍需要对应工程的编辑权限和版本检查。

## 使用限制

FFmpeg/ffprobe 等可选工具需要单独安装和配置，见[外部依赖](https://github.com/yuchen-ya/reelterminal/blob/49cd32db21d7ebc1a04388db9edbdc300fb0fe69/docs/EXTERNAL-DEPENDENCIES.md)。视频保持 SDR 8-bit 边界；缺少完整色彩标记的源可能在预览与导出间出现色差，HDR/10-bit 色彩保留不支持。请一并规范源像素和色彩标记，并在交付前检查输出，见[色彩说明](https://github.com/yuchen-ya/reelterminal/blob/49cd32db21d7ebc1a04388db9edbdc300fb0fe69/docs/COLOR.md)。软件渲染需要额外 CPU 工作，高分辨率播放可能无法实时。

Windows x64 发行包未签名，系统可能显示发布者或 SmartScreen 提示；请从官方发行页下载并核对校验和。升级前保留工程与素材，见[升级与备份指南](https://github.com/yuchen-ya/reelterminal/blob/49cd32db21d7ebc1a04388db9edbdc300fb0fe69/docs/WINDOWS-UPGRADE.md)。其他平台以发行页实际列出的资产为准。实验性独立批次审阅仍已退役，不自动删除或迁移原有数据。

## Changes

- Add atomic final-layout batch editing, anchor-based retiming and explicit transition handle policies through the CLI.
- Render deterministic local HTML/CSS/SVG animation and animate SVG stroke trim paths.
- Preserve transparent WebM overlays in preview, stills and export, and encode generated WebM with matching SDR BT.709 pixels and color tags.
- Remix music to a target duration, explicitly register generated audio, and shape a ducking tail swell.
- Export attached covers, SRT subtitles and chapter text from the export-start snapshot.
- Stream local media up to 8 GiB through the desktop CLI and reject source changes during copying.
- Improve JSON input guidance for Windows shells. Use shared command help for exact parameters.

New structured operations are CLI features. FFmpeg/ffprobe require separate configuration. Listen to remixed music before using it; beat-based repetition is not suitable for every source. HTML rendering does not e

release.raw_body:
SpektraLab 2.4.2 for the Mac: compatibility and stability.

- **macOS 14 Sonoma or later**: SpektraLab now runs on macOS 14 as well as 15 and later. On macOS 14 a few small things are not there: the stock strip does not scroll a chosen film or paper into view, and a click away from a text field does not end its editing (Return, Esc or Tab does).
- **LibRaw as an optional RAW decoder**: **Settings › Develop › RAW decoder** offers **Apple (macOS)**, the default and what every earlier version used, or **LibRaw**, an open-source decoder. LibRaw reads some cameras macOS does not, and its colour and highlights differ from Apple's, so the same photograph develops differently, at about the same exposure. It runs in a process of its own, so a file that trips it cannot take the app down; a file it cannot read is decoded by Apple's. With LibRaw, macOS's own lens correction is not available (the lens database's and a file's own profiles still are). Switching develops the open pictures again; what was developed with Apple's decoder is kept and comes back when you switch back.
- **Licences**: LibRaw is used, unmodified, under the LGPL-2.1, in a separate helper inside the app. Its notices are in the disk image's **Licenses** folder, and the README says how to rebuild the helper from source.

**Download:** `SpektraLab-2.4.2-universal.dmg`, one download for Apple silicon and Intel Macs (macOS 14 or later). Signed with Developer ID and notarised by Apple.

release.raw_body:
## 这次修的是「下载提示 HTTP 504」

504 是**加速线路的网关超时**：那条线路去 GitHub 取数据没按时拿到，返回了 504。
不是文件坏了，也不是软件出错。常见原因是镜像站当时挂了/限流，或者你的网络出口拦了 GitHub 相关域名。

### 以前为什么会卡很久才报错

旧版遇到 504 会在**同一条线路**上重试 3 次，8 条线路就是 24 次超时请求，
真实网络下要白等好几分钟，最后只丢出一个 `HTTP 504`。

### 现在怎么处理

- **线路从 8 条扩到 20 条**，测速每条只读 1MB，8 秒没反应就判不通、自动沉底
- **504/502/503 立刻换线**：5xx 只在同一条线路上补试 1 次（0.7 秒），4xx 直接换，不再死磕
- **挂掉的线路自动拉黑**：本轮任务后面的文件直接跳过它，不重复踩坑
- **连撞 3 条线路级失败就停**，不在 20 条线路上挨个等超时
- **自动重试一次**：整轮网络类失败后等 2 秒、清空黑名单再试一遍，状态列显示「自动重试中…」
- **提示改成中文**：`所有线路都超时（HTTP 504）· 网络受限或镜像临时故障，稍后再点「开始下载」可续传`

### 还可以自己补线路

exe 同目录放 `routes.txt`，一行一条，`名称|前缀` 或只写前缀：

```
我的线路|https://gh.example.com/
https://another.example.com/
```

保存后重开（或点「重新测速」）即可参与测速，能用的排前面。镜像换域名不用等软件更新。
`GitHub下载整理工具.exe --routes` 可打印当前生效的线路表。

### 实测（`tools/err_srv.py`）

| 场景 | 请求数 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 单线路全 504 | 2（旧版 3） | 0.8 秒给出中文原因 |
| 3 条线路全 504 | 6（旧版 9） | 2.4 秒 |
| 20 条线路全 504 | 12（旧版 60） | 6.4 秒（含一次自动重试） |
| 20MB 全 504 | 26（旧版 88） | 2 秒放弃分片 + 单连接兜底 |
| 前 3 条 504、第 4 条正常 | 26 | 6.4 秒下完，md5 一致 |
| 一次抖动（第 1 个请求 504） | 2 | 自动重试后成功，md5 一致 |

**下载**：`GitHub-Release-Downloader-v1.6.3.exe`，双击即用，免安装。

# nv-uefi-unlocker v2.1.11

**v2.1.11 — 制盘下载与 GSP 来源的结构性升级（本地优先）+ TU106 台架五版本 GSP 谱系实测**

## 主要变化 / What's new

### 1. 本地驱动 GSP 成为默认资产来源（badge 模式）/ Local driver GSP is now the default asset source ("badge mode")

多数制盘机都装着 NVIDIA 驱动——驱动仓库里本来就带着分代 GSP 固件（Windows `C:\Windows\System32\DriverStore\FileRepository\nv*inf_amd64_*\gsp_ga10x.bin + gsp_tu10x.bin`；Linux `/usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/<版本>/gsp_*.bin`，NixOS 等另探 `/run/current-system/firmware/`）。**v2.1.11 起 `make-usbroot` 默认优先取本地驱动的 GSP，找不到才回退网络下载**：

- Windows：扫描 DriverStore，从 `.inf` 解析 `DriverVer`，多仓库取最新；
- Linux：`/usr/lib|/lib|/run/current-system` firmware 下 `sort -V` 取最高版本；
- 本地路径 = **badge 模式**：版本钉定豁免（实测依据见下），fwimage+fwsignature 由同一容器天然成对；
- pre-52x 老驱动（单一多代 `gsp.bin`，无 `.fwimage` 段）会被指名拒绝并回退下载链；
- **显式参数**：`-UtilsSource arch|run|cachyos|local`（bash `--utils-source`）可钉定任一通道，`local` = 只用本地驱动 GSP；下载通道的哈希闸语义不变。

**效果**：装了 N 卡驱动的机器上，315 MB 的 nvidia-utils 下载默认消失，只剩 26 MB kernel-source（booter/BL/scrubber 的 BINDATA 内嵌在 `nvlddmkm.sys` 里，不是可拷贝文件，仍走钉定下载）。实测兼容的旧 assets 二进制同样可用（`gsp-sections` 早已存在，无新依赖）。

Most stick-building machines already have the NVIDIA driver installed, and the driver store ships the split GSP firmware ELFs. `make-usbroot` now tries the LOCAL driver's GSP first and falls back to the pinned downloads only when no local store is found: `auto = local DriverStore (badge mode) -> Arch archive -> first-party NVIDIA .run -> CachyOS cache`; pin one route with `-UtilsSource arch|run|cachyos|local`. Local is badge mode (version pin waived; fwimage+fwsignature paired by construction; pre-52x single-ELF stores are refused with a named reason and fall through). Net effect: no 315 MB download on driver-equipped hosts - only the 26 MB kernel source still downloads (booter/BL/scrubber BINDATA is embedded in nvlddmkm.sys, not a copyable file).

### 2. GSP 在解锁链里是什么 / What the GSP actually is in the unlock chain

GSP-RM 镜像在本管线中的全部角色：**砸门的工牌**。payload 模式下，WprMeta 的 signature DMA 指向 V67 载荷，booter 的签名拷贝越界即触发 ROP——对 GSP 镜像自身的任何校验都在那之后（门已开）。事务对镜像的全部依赖面是三个只吃"尺寸"的纯函数（layout / radix / WprMeta image_bytes）。真正的版本咬合三件套——booter、GspRmBoot BL、FWSEC——全不来自 nvidia-utils 包。机制详见 [docs/gsp-compatibility.md](https://github.com/physicsdolphin/nv-uefi-unlocker/blob/main/docs/gsp-compatibility.md)。

In the unlock chain the GSP image is just the badge that smashes the FEAT gate open: in payload mode the WprMeta signature DMA aims at the V67 blob, so the booter's own verification of the image never runs before the ROP fires. The transactio

release.summary_zh:

- 当多个规则共享的代理达到其使用限制时，通知卡不再报告尚未发生的恢复，并且其措辞更加清晰（#376）。
release.raw_body:
## 改了什么

- 规则可以写可选的 `tags`（一组文字）。中台不解释它，原样带进 `/v1/state` 的状态行、轮次、卡片，`/v1/runs` 的每一项，以及这条规则每一轮的资料文件，方便客户端按项目分组显示、Agent 知道这一轮属于哪一组。没写 `tags` 的规则和以前一样。注意：老版本中台不认识这个字段会拒收规则文件，先升级中台再写（#380，修 #371）。
- 飞书卡片发不出去时（比如登录过期、机器人缺权限），日志和失败说明直接写原因和该怎么办：缺权限的指向飞书开发者后台，不再贴出 lark-cli 的一大段原始返回（#374）。
- 几条规则共用的 Agent 用量额度到上限时，那张通知卡片不再误报已恢复，提示的说法也更清楚（#376）。
- 接单程序启动 Agent 失败或插件报错时，失败说明不再被切掉半个字符（#377，修 #375）。

感谢 xdAsaah、xiao fan、argszero、Ryan Wang。

## What's changed

- Rules can carry optional `tags` (a list of strings). The hub doesn't interpret them; it passes them unchanged into the status lines, runs and cards of `/v1/state`, every item of `/v1/runs`, and each run's job file for that rule, so clients can group by project and agents know which group a run belongs to. Rules without `tags` behave as before. Note: an older hub rejects a rules file with this field, so upgrade the hub before adding it (#380, fixes #371).
- When a Feishu card is refused (an expired login, a bot missing a permission), the log and the failure note say why and what to do — a missing bot permission points to the Feishu developer console — instead of dumping lark-cli's raw response (#374).
- When agents shared by several rules hit their usage limit, the notice card no longer reports a recovery that hasn't happened, and its wording is clearer (#376).
- When the worker fails to launch an agent or a plugin reports an error, the failure text no longer ends in half a character (#377, fixes #375).

Thanks to xdAsaah, xiao fan, argszero and Ryan Wang.

- `OM.music({burst,peak,landing})`：在可能的情况下，将轨道的真正升力带入电影的爆发和峰值。当它不能时，表格会说明影片中要移动的内容（按多少节拍）。
- 每个候选安排都经过渲染和测量；一首突然响度跳跃的曲目不会让自己被拒绝。
release.raw_body:
## Score a film with a real track

Until now `om sound` synthesized the music. From 0.6.0 a film is scored with a real track, arranged to the film's length.

**What's new**

- `om sound <dir> --music <file>` or `OM.music({ src })`: use any track — your own, one you generated, or one from the default library. The track keeps its own opening and its own ending; the middle is shortened or repeated in whole bars; joins sit inside stable stretches, never across a lift.
- `OM.music({ burst, peak, landing })`: a real lift of the track is brought onto the film's burst and peak when it can be. When it cannot, the table says what to move in the film (by how many beats).
- Every candidate arrangement is rendered and measured; one with a sudden loudness jump the track does not make itself is refused.
- Real beats: `OM.beat / OM.downbeat / OM.drop` follow the track's analysed beat grid; `om check` flags cuts that are off the beat.
- `om beats <file|dir> [--plot]`: tempo, bar lines, lifts, opening and ending of a track.
- `om music` (list / build / use / add): a default library of 11 instrumental tracks, downloaded from the [music-v1](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion/releases/tag/music-v1) release and checked by sha256, plus your own tracks. All library tracks are AI-generated; licence in `music/LICENSE.md`.
- With a real track, sound effects sit 8 dB lighter. Composing a score in code is now the fallback, not the default.

**Nothing changes** for a film that already has an `om-score` or no music declared: it renders as before.

**Update**: `npx huashu-motion@latest`, or `git pull --ff-only` in a cloned skill folder.

---

从 0.6.0 起，宣传片用真实的曲子配乐，并按片长自动改编：曲子自己的开头和结尾原样保留，中段按整小节伸缩，抬升连同它的过门不被切开；片子的爆发和高潮尽量对上曲子真实的抬升；出现突然的响度变化的拼法会被直接否决。`om music` 提供 11 首默认曲目（全部 AI 生成，许可见 `music/LICENSE.md`），也可以登记自己的曲子。已有的片子不受影响。更新：`npx huashu-motion@latest`，或在克隆的 skill 目录里 `git pull --ff-only`。

repos.desc_zh: 从主题或文章制作完整手绘讲解视频：按部位描线、逐字书写、VoiceStudio 配音、五项内置制作依赖。

release.summary_zh:
- **油画**：块面写生的顺序：起稿 → 脸 → 头发 → 五官 → 衣服 → 背景 → 推近深入 → 落款。每笔有自己的压力、含色量和弯度；脸从暗部成片往外长，手离开一块区域时不留洞；轮廓不再是锯齿；最后几笔厚涂亮部。
- **素描**：一笔就是一支铅笔的一条线，石墨叠加变深，不从成品里「取」深浅。先起形，头发先用笔侧铺色调再画发丝，五官早早定下深色；揉擦、提亮时换纸擦笔和橡皮。
- **动漫插画**：草稿 → 线稿（每根线一笔画完，有入笔和出锋）→ 平涂（每块先沿边走一笔，再一条不抬笔的来回路线涂满，背景先整片涂满再画上面的植物）→ 阴影、高光 → 渐变 → 眼睛 → 签名。
release.raw_body:
# v3.1.0

新增人像绘画实验室（`labs/oil-portrait/`）：给一张人像照片，得到一部「一笔一笔画出来」的过程视频，三种画法：油画、素描、动漫插画。整个流程是一条命令，换用较小的模型来驱动也能得到同样的片子。

手绘口播 Skill 本身（`skills/sweety-handdraw-video/`）与 v3.0.2 相同，安装包只更新了版本号。人像绘画在仓库里运行，不在安装包里。

## 1. 一条命令出片

```bash
python3 labs/oil-portrait/make.py setup                          # 第一次：检查环境，缺人脸关键点环境会自动装
python3 labs/oil-portrait/make.py run 照片.jpg --kind sketch      # oil | sketch | anime | all
python3 labs/oil-portrait/make.py status                         # 每个任务的验收结论和成片路径
```

流程：照片裁成 2:3（以脸为中心）→ 图像模型画线稿、分区图、目标画 → 自动标注五官 → 规划笔画 → 出片 → 配乐 → 封面 → 验收。成片在 `output/paint/`：带音乐的 `film.mp4`、无声版、成品图、目标画、无水印封面和验收报告。

以前要靠人（或驱动工具的模型）看图决定的事，现在都在代码里：

| 以前 | 现在 |
|---|---|
| 看图手写眼睛、嘴、鼻子、脸的坐标 | `annotate.py`：人脸关键点（MediaPipe，单独的环境）加分区图算出来，带合理性检查（左右眼、上下顺序、都在脸内） |
| 按照片改提示词（「按照片补充…」） | 固定的通用提示词 |
| 看生成的图能不能用 | 自动校验：和照片对不对得上（偏了就挪回去）、是不是这张照片、分区图是不是四种纯色；不合格重画，最多 3 次 |
| 选裁剪、签名位置、音乐、手 | 固定规则 |
| 看成片好不好 | `check.py` 九项验收：片长、开场封面、结尾停留、手的移动、漏涂、和目标画的相似度、眼睛标注落在瞳孔上、响度、交付文件 |

给模型的操作手册是 `labs/oil-portrait/RUNBOOK.md`，仓库根目录的 `CLAUDE.md` 指向它。

## 2. 三种画法

- **油画**：块面写生的顺序：起稿 → 脸 → 头发 → 五官 → 衣服 → 背景 → 推近深入 → 落款。每笔有自己的压力、含色量和弯度；脸从暗部成片往外长，手离开一块区域时不留洞；轮廓不再是锯齿；最后几笔厚涂亮部。
- **素描**：一笔就是一支铅笔的一条线，石墨叠加变深，不从成品里「取」深浅。先起形，头发先用笔侧铺色调再画发丝，五官早早定下深色；揉擦、提亮时换纸擦笔和橡皮。
- **动漫插画**：草稿 → 线稿（每根线一笔画完，有入笔和出锋）→ 平涂（每块先沿边走一笔，再一条不抬笔的来回路线涂满，背景先整片涂满再画上面的植物）→ 阴影、高光 → 渐变 → 眼睛 → 签名。

三种都是：开场先显示成品 0.5 秒再淡出到空白画布，结尾镜头缓推、展示成品 6 秒。

## 3. 没有手，只有笔尖

用户转来的网友反馈：「其实没有那只手是更好的……用苹果的笔触来代替，一笔笔画完。」现在默认不再画握笔的手，只显示平板绘画软件那样的笔尖光标：落笔时是笔刷大小的圆圈加当前颜色的圆点，抬笔时是淡一些的悬停圈，开头淡入、结尾淡出。要用以前的手：`film.py RUN --hand tang`。

## 4. 配乐

有曲库（`skills/sweety-handdraw-video/assets/music/`，不随仓库发布）时，按画法从各自的曲目里挑一首比片子长的：油画偏抒情，素描偏安静，动漫偏轻快；三张清单互不重叠，同一张照片的三部片子不会撞曲。先测量片段响度再统一增益到 −16 LUFS。没有曲库时用合成音乐。

## 5. 验证

- `labs/oil-portrait/tests/test_pipeline.py`：15 项，测自动化的每一步：提示词没有待填空、标注落在眼睛上、偏移的图能挪回、不是这张照片的线稿会被拒、共用的图只生成一次、同一张图关键点不变、同样的输入规划结果逐字节相同、漏涂检测分得清好坏。
- 三张照片 × 三种画法用最终代码出片：9 部中 8 部通过验收。没通过的一部是油画，漏底 65 像素（标准 60），是 3 个肉眼看不出的小点。
- 换模型测试：只给照片和一句「三种画法都做」，Haiku 和 Sonnet 各自读到操作手册、在后台跑完、没改任何代码，并如实报告了没通过的项。同样的输入，三种引擎画出来逐字节相同，所以谁来驱动，片子都一样。这次测试还找出两个问题，已修：`--kind all` 时三种画法同时生成共用的图、互相覆盖；操作手册缺「验收没通过时怎么办」。

## 已知局限

- 素描遇到飘散的碎发和露出的耳朵时，会把碎发画成一团糊、耳朵画花。这类「画得不好」验收量不出来，是下一步要改的。
- 只调好了油画的默认风格（块面写生），另外四种风格仍用旧画法。
- 动漫插画的片子偏长（约 2 分半）。
- 需要额外约 700 MB 的人脸关键点环境，以及 Codex 的图像生成。
- 照片、目标画、视频都只在本地 `output/`，不进仓库。

release.raw_body:
Self-hosting files for Web/Docker, macOS and Windows installers, and Linux x64 AppImage and .deb packages.

macOS installers are Developer ID signed and notarized. Windows installers have no publisher certificate; Windows may warn or block installation. Historical clients without an update key need one manual overwrite upgrade.
All application update packages have verified Tauri updater signatures. Local device execution runs in a signed sandbox runtime (sourceweft-sandbox-*.tar.gz, verified with the same updater key) that the app downloads and verifies on first use, on macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Linux x86_64 and Windows (x64 and arm64).
See docker/README.md in the self-hosting archive for installation and upgrade instructions. Translations are provided in separate README files.


## What's Changed
* feat(sso): enterprise single sign-on with OIDC and SAML 2.0 (#534) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/586
* feat(connectors): one shared selection component for every connector; Dropbox runs on it (#25) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/593
* chore(deps): upgrade Next.js to 16.4.5 to clear the dependency audit (#601) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/603
* feat(gmail): connect Gmail through Composio with live tools only by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/585
* chore(deps): ignore the unpatched picomatch advisory in the audit (#601) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/608
* feat(agent-tasks): data model and schedule specs (#571) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/599
* fix(deps): exempt the unpatched picomatch advisory from the audit gate (#609) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/610
* fix(chat): keep concurrent chat preference saves from overwriting each other (#482) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/596
* fix(web): tidy the macOS client's titlebar row beside the traffic lights (#180) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/597
* fix(skills): a new draft retires the older drafts of the same skill (#595) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/598
* refactor(study): share evidence contracts, corpus, anchoring and generation job plumbing (#591) by @QThans in https://github.com/SourceWeft/SourceWeft/pull/614

release.raw_body:
## New Features

- Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection. (#62106)
- Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation. (#61352, #61888, #61889, #61919, #62157)
- Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes. (#61954)
- Added `codex exec --remote <ADDR>` to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server. (#61707)
- Added `/rc` and `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes from the TUI. (#62121)
- Added custom MCP status line selection and authoring through `/statusline` when `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled. (#61979, #61988, #62037)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserved drafts, queued follow-ups, and interrupted input with their original threads when switching or resuming sessions. (#61216)
- Kept permission profiles intact when changing working directories. (#61195)
- Prevented late completion events from cancelling approvals for a newer turn. (#61801)
- Preserved earlier edits in aggregate diffs when steering an active turn. (#61820)
- Fixed scrolling that inserted stray characters, composer caret jumps, and redraws using stale terminal dimensions. (#62139, #62174, #62175)
- Fixed enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens. (#62129)

## Chores

- Updated source builds and release tooling to Rust 1.99.1. (#61205)
- Updated XML dependencies and removed obsolete security advisory exceptions. (#62068)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.170.0...rust-v0.171.0

- #61178 Enable conversation-scoped speed selection for Cloud turns @bc-openai

- #61182 Support renaming cloud threads @bc-openai
- #61183 Fix fork parent metadata in reconstructed TUI sessions @fcoury-oai
- #61185 Defer Guardian context limits to request preparation @ioanbudea-OAI
- #61186 Keep plan item IDs unique after completion @neerajrj-oai
- #61187 Add authenticated GCS caching for Bazel CI and releases @dkovalenko-oai

release.raw_body:
# DeepTutor v1.7.4 Release Notes

**Release Date:** 2026.11.20

This desktop security update replaces the runtime signing key used by the macOS and Windows apps. On November 20, desktop release credentials were exposed in GitHub Actions artifacts. Those artifacts have been removed.

## What's New

The desktop app verifies runtime updates with a new public key. When it finds a saved runtime signed with the retired key, it installs the verified runtime bundled with the new app and backs up the existing workspace before starting it. Tagged desktop builds now require maintainer approval to access release credentials.

## Upgrade Notes

- **macOS:** Download the v1.7.4 DMG for your Mac (Apple Silicon or Intel), quit DeepTutor, and replace the old app in Applications. If macOS blocks the old app from launching, install the replacement directly.
- **Windows:** Quit DeepTutor and use the v1.7.4 installer or portable ZIP. The Windows installer and portable app use the same new runtime verification key.
- Install the desktop app itself to receive the new public key. Earlier desktop versions still trust the retired key. Until you upgrade, avoid importing core updates into those versions.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HKUDS/DeepTutor/compare/v1.7.3...v1.7.4

release.raw_body:
中文：

- 全网搜索、Reddit、小红书、B站在 1.6.0 里会出现的几种"明明能查却报错"或"显示成功但内容是空的"，这版都修好了。
- 电脑上别的软件占用了浏览器端口时，可以换一个端口，不用关掉那个软件。
- 复制登录失败时会如实告诉你，不再假装成功。
- Windows 上小红书带特殊符号的链接能正常打开了。

English:

- Several 1.6.0 cases where web search, Reddit, Xiaohongshu or Bilibili failed although the content was reachable, or reported success with empty content, are fixed.
- When another program on your computer uses the browser port, Agent Reach can use a different one; you don't have to close that program.
- A login copy that fails now says so instead of reporting success.
- On Windows, Xiaohongshu links with special characters open correctly.

中文（技术细节）：
- 全网搜索：请求统一带上 `agent-reach/<版本号>` 标识，避免被 Exa 的防护拦截（#877）。
- Reddit：站内工具临时失败（比如返回网页而不是数据）时，自动改用公开网页搜索和阅读（#880）。
- 小红书：适配 OpenCLI 2.0 的返回格式，阅读不再"成功但内容全空"；搜索和评论没有结果时也不再返回一条空数据（#861、#895）。
- B站：扫码后如果没存下有效登录，不再显示登录成功；提示改为运行 `agent-reach login bilibili`（#866、#883）。
- 专用浏览器端口可以改：`agent-reach configure browser-port <端口>`，9222 被别的软件占用时用（#848）。
- 复制登录：浏览器后台程序没开时不再记一次"复制了 0 条"；手动 `login <渠道> --import-existing` 一条都没复制到时会明确报错（#879）。
- Windows：链接里带 `&` 的小红书笔记能正常阅读和查看评论（#860）。

English (technical):
- Web search: every request identifies itself as `agent-reach/<version>`, so Exa's Cloudflare front no longer blocks it (#877).
- Reddit: when the site tool fails transiently (for example it returns HTML instead of data), search and read fall back to the public web (#880).
- Xiaohongshu: OpenCLI 2.0 results are mapped, so read no longer succeeds with empty fields; search and comments no longer return one empty row when there are no results (#861, #895).
- Bilibili: a QR login that saved no usable credential is no longer reported as success, and the hint now says `agent-reach login bilibili` (#866, #883).
- The dedicated browser's port is configurable with `agent-reach configure browser-port <port>`, for when another tool holds 9222 (#848).
- Login reuse: no "copied 0 cookies" record when the browser bridge is down; an explicit `login <channel> --import-existing` that copies nothing now fails clearly (#879).
- Windows: Xiaohongshu note links containing `&` can be read and their comments loaded (#860).

release.raw_body:
## 修正

・**PoE1 新通貨無法查價**：Originator's Exalted Orb、Primordial Exalted Orb 可以解析並查價了。（繁中客戶端目前顯示英文名）
・**PoE1 遊戲還沒翻譯的物品無法解析**：繁中客戶端顯示英文名的物品，改用英文名比對。
・**PoE1 勾選三條輔助寶石詞綴後查價失敗**：不再出現「Query is too complex」。
・**PoE1 部分詞綴勾選後查到 0 筆**：補上交易站實際使用的 18 個 id。（例：擊中稀有或傳奇敵人時觸發盜獵者印記）

release.raw_body:
## Commit-pinned installation

Copy the complete command for your operating system into PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (macOS/Ubuntu). Use the same command to install or update.

### Windows 11 x64 or ARM64

```powershell
$commit="0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a"; $env:SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT=$commit; irm "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.ps1" | iex
```

Windows finishes installation without automatically opening the app. Finish any recording, choose **Quit** in all running Skill Recorder copies, then open **Skill Recorder (Source)** from the desktop or Start menu. Follow the completion notice if a manual launch command is needed.

### macOS or Ubuntu

Quit older running copies before updating, then run:

```sh
commit="0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a"; curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.sh" | SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT="$commit" bash
```

For script inspection and hash verification before execution, use the [inspect-first instructions](https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/blob/0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a/INSTALL.md#inspect-first-installation).

## Fixes

- **Recover fresh installations blocked by ONNX Runtime license-download failures.** If the pinned upstream legal-file URLs are unavailable, installation reports the failure and tries explicit version-pinned jsDelivr recovery URLs.
- **Preserve license verification.** Every recovered license and notice must match its existing reviewed SHA-256. Original source references and approved hashes are unchanged; mismatched content and HTML error pages are rejected.
- Retain recovery alternatives in `REMOTE-MATERIALS.json`, document recovery behavior, and add regression coverage for upstream failure, cache verification, recovery failure, and invalid content.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- This is a compatible patch release. Application dependency versions and existing compliance approvals are unchanged.
- Commands pinned to `63bbb50111713b02f3bc0ebbd5f354f4eb038f99` (0.9.2) retain the old behavior. Use the complete command above to obtain the fix; rerunning the old command will not update it.
- Recovery downloads require access to `cdn.jsdelivr.net` when the original upstream is unavailable. Verification is never bypassed if neither source is accessible.
- Recordings and application data remain in their existing locations.

## Source-only release

release.raw_body:
GPU Unlock 1.1.1 publishes a reproducible SM89 tensor issue-rate probe and matched stock/unlocked TF32 and unsigned INT4 results on one RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (`10de:2705`, NVIDIA `580.178.04`, 240 W cap). The Ada unlock transaction is unchanged from 1.1.0; the module and DKMS version metadata advance to 1.1.1.

| Register-resident mode | Stock | Unlocked |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| FP16 inputs, FP32 accumulate (control) | 94.96 TF/s | 188.97 TF/s |
| TF32 inputs, FP32 accumulate | 47.49 TF/s | 94.51 TF/s |
| Unsigned INT4 inputs, INT32 accumulate | 754.81 TOP/s | 754.68 TOP/s |

The same cubin, card, driver, 240 W cap, and launch settings were used in both boots. Each mode checked 270,336 output cells with zero mismatches per state. **TF32 instruction issue rate gained 1.99×; unsigned INT4 did not improve.** These all-one, register-resident loops do not establish an application GEMM or inference speedup. INT8 and one previously tested FP8 GEMM were also unchanged.

Read the [canary report](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/blob/v1.1.1/docs/ada-2705-report.md), [sanitized numeric output and hashes](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/tree/v1.1.1/docs/evidence/ada2705), and [GPL benchmark source and reproduction steps](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/blob/v1.1.1/diagnostics/bench/README.md). Installation and boot rollback are in the [Quick Start](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada/blob/v1.1.1/QUICKSTART.md).

The exact source-only archive ran 22 Linux host tests with 8 optional-input skips, and its kernel module compiled against the tested host's `5.15.0-177-generic` headers as version 1.1.1. The owner miner stayed running through this CPU-only validation. The downloadable archive contains no NVIDIA firmware binary; pinned NVIDIA inputs are generated locally under NVIDIA's separate license.

## Additional FP8 evidence — October 23, 2026

The earlier unchanged FP8 result was the selected staged-accumulation kernel. A later custom harness using NVIDIA CUTLASS 4.8.1's fast-accumulation GEMM measured **158.54 -> 309.08 dense TFLOP/s (1.949527x)** for 8192x8192x8192 on the same RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, same CUBIN and same 240 W cap. The requested core ceiling was 2400 MHz; unlocked core boundary samples were 2265/2370 MHz versus 2400/2400 MHz stock, with normal 10251 MHz memory in both states. This is a same-power-cap measurement, not clock-normalized throughput.

release.raw_body:
## v2.9.0

### 免费车道

- **出口池**：额度按出口 IP 计数，所以一个出口被限流时，车道现在会在**同一回合内**换下一个。出口在设置页按行填写，地址后加 `#pool`（或前缀 `pool+`）表示轮换池端点——每次连接换 IP，因此从不冷却。每回合最多换几个出口可调（1–8）。
- **限流窗口封顶 30 分钟**：上游（或它前面的 CDN/WAF）曾下发 `Retry-After: 70411`，把出口锁近 20 小时，而它 17 分钟后已恢复 200。现在单次 429 最多锁 30 分钟；磁盘上遗留的超长窗口在读取时同样截断。
- **修复回归：请求不可取消**。换出口重构时把调用方的 `AbortSignal` 覆盖成了 `undefined`，导致所有经出口的请求（含 Bun 子进程）无法中止。
- **本地锁有出口了**：车道被本地拒绝时，设置页顶部出现横幅，说明这是插件自己的保护、何时解除，并给出「解除车道锁定」按钮。此前该按钮在未配置出口时是灰的——而那正是最需要它的时候。
- 出口地址填错现在返回 **400** 而不是 500。

### 官方工具面

- **官方名只承载官方定义**：实测调用方工具撞上官方名（`bash` → `shell`）会被上游判成 429。现在只有声明与官方定义逐字一致时才占用官方名，其余一律走 `mcp_<hash>`，官方 13 工具照常逐字注入；重复声明按 wire name 去重。
- **修复回归：真实 MCP 工具名被截断**。`mcp__github__search` 曾被截成 `_github__search`——一个调用方从未声明的工具。句柄改为按完整形状识别，非句柄名原样透传。

### EAC 名册

- 修复整份封印名册被压成单张 `[object Object]` 卡片的缺陷：`parseListing` 现在返回整行供 `buildCatalog` 读取容量，而 `buildEacCatalog` 需要裸 id。两侧都修正，并过滤旧版写入的无效 `sealIds`。

### 公告

- 撤下的紧急公告不再对**已缓存它**的老安装反复弹全屏：缓存超过 2 小时即失去打断权，条目仍留在列表里。

### 来源与许可

- `src/token-saver/rtk` → `compact` 重命名；o2a 身份与工具名模块重写（8 个同名函数全部改名，旧名零残留）。
- `LICENSE` 补第三方许可附录：opencode（MIT）、RTK（Apache-2.0）、9router（MIT）全文与使用说明。附录内联在 `LICENSE` 里而非独立文件，因为旧升级器对发行集有 80 文件硬上限，而发行集正好 80。
- `scripts/probes/` 下 8 个探针脚本标注 9router 来源（MIT 文件头）；它们不进发行集。

### 升级说明

升级不修改现有账号、配置与归档。清单与 `catalog/integrity.json` 已重签（80 文件 / 33947585 字节）。

**验证**：全套测试 124/124；从真实 npm tarball 加载实机 14/14；独立端实机 21/21；宿主挂载实机 14/14；清单按「已安装用户」视角校验 17/17（含签名）。

release.raw_body:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.3

**Release Date:** November 19, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~370 PRs merged since v0.23.2 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `caafe5389ae`, the window since v0.23.2 contains **1,657 non-merge commits** across **3,948 changed files** (+222,379 / −96,154), **370 merged PRs** and **60 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: one prompt-cache lifecycle controller (warming through long tool runs, compaction of idle chats before the 1h cache expires, Nous Portal on the full 1h lifecycle, `prompt_caching.cache_ttl` defaulting to `auto`), compaction that archives the tool results it drops, the proactive tool-result prune on by default, a one-question first-run CLI setup with the free tier included, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (+ Pro) on OpenRouter and Nous Portal, a "Waiting on teammates" strip above Bot Chat composers, the Linux AppImage agent payload run from a stable per-build copy, the storage layer split behind a persistence interface with its SQLite backend, dependency security bumps (oauthlib, opentelemetry, tornado), and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.2...v0.23.3](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.2...v0.23.3)

GenOffice v0.13.615 stable desktop installers. The headline of this release is Docs: the menu bar, ribbon and right-click menu now follow Word for Mac, with most of Word's dialogs behind them.

## What's New

- **Docs:** menus and ribbon tabs are laid out as in Word for Mac, with Word's dialogs behind them (Document, Paragraph, Font, Borders and Shading, Bullets and Numbering, Footnote and Endnote, Index and Tables and more); Compare and Combine Documents; templates, Insert > File and Insert > Icons; grouping and aligning floating objects; Zotero citations (@pemdesign); nested tables break across pages like Word (@mubaroqadb); faster typing in long documents (@tokg-venv).
- **Sheets:** Excel's regex functions and PERCENTOF (@vinirib); a copied range also lands on the Windows clipboard as a picture (@tokg-venv); legacy `.xls` files keep their real colors; the ribbon fits narrower windows (@mubaroqadb); the cell editor stays on its cell while the grid scrolls (@Xtzdd).
- **Slides:** legacy `.ppt` text decoding and outline fixes (@aniruddhaadak80); new elements get the right paragraph spacing (@widechaos).
- **PDF:** edit the recognized-text layer in place, with a Recognize Text command (@tokg-venv); right-to-left inserts and line-end hyphens (@aniruddhaadak80); smoother upscaled page images (@krakotay); steadier page deletion and text insertion (@widechaos).
- **OpenDocument:** `.odt` tables, lists, spacing, backgrounds and repeated header rows convert more faithfully (@Zhangs-11, @aniruddhaadak80).
- **App:** Hungarian as a UI language (@tatargabor); 80% and 90% interface scale (@mubaroqadb); restyled Settings and a sign-out confirmation (@rsmp15); network folders on Linux (@jmkim) and Linux system fonts (@FeiLiuEM); nested lists in AI document HTML (@jayhemnani9910); AI attachments read Word, Excel and PowerPoint files more accurately (@Zhangs-11); security hardening for settings files, file channels and imports, and Electron 43.8.10 (@tokg-venv).

## 获取方式

### Docker（多架构 linux/amd64 / linux/arm64）

```bash
docker pull docker.io/bestzwei/libretv:2.24.0
docker pull ghcr.io/librespark/libretv:2.24.0
```

两个 registry 的镜像内容一致（同一组 digest），`latest` 也指向本版本。

### 免 Docker（下方附件，Node 18+）

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
tar -xzf libretv-2.24.0-standalone.tar.gz -C libretv
cd libretv && PASSWORD=your-password PORT=8080 node server.js
```

预构建包与 CPU 架构无关（x86_64 / arm64 / armv7），环境变量与 Docker 部署一致。

> 镜像由 docker-publish 工作流在同一 tag 上构建，刚发布时可能还要 5–10 分钟才可拉取。

## English

### Summary

Model selectors now let you adjust reasoning and other supported parameters where you use the model. You can give two tests of the same model different settings and compare their responses on the same input. This release also restores reasoning text in results and refreshes the project documentation.

### Highlights

- Choose a model and adjust its available reasoning settings in the same menu.
- Start from the saved model defaults and adjust parameters independently for each workspace or Arena column.
- Read reasoning text as it streams and reopen it after the response finishes.

### Product Updates

#### Desktop

- Text and image model selectors show a compact parameter summary and give you access to the selected model's controls.

#### Web

- Arena columns can use the same model with different settings. Each column applies its own parameters to the shared test input.
- The project homepage and README show updated product screenshots. The documentation homepage gives direct access to setup, workspace selection, and result comparison.

#### Extension

- Adjust supported switches, choices, or numeric values in the model menu and use the reset action to return to the saved defaults.

#### Core/Infra

- Apply local overrides during text and image requests while retaining compatible settings from the stored configuration.

### Fixes

- Restore the reasoning section in supported workspaces and Arena when the model returns reasoning text. Long lines wrap during streaming and in completed results.
- Render bold Markdown correctly when emphasized Chinese text ends in punctuation.

### Breaking Changes / Upgrade Notes

- Existing model configurations continue to supply the defaults for workspaces after upgrading.
- The browser extension ZIP uses version `2.16.0`.

### Developer Notes

- Parameter tests cover independent settings for the same model, inheritance and reset, and restoring saved text and image selections.
- The reasoning browser regression checks the output during generation, after completion, and after reload in the user-prompt workspace and Arena.

release.raw_body:
# v0.32.0: Zone counting, dwell time and semantic segmentation

## 📋 Summary

supervision now counts objects entering and leaving a zone, times how long each one stays, and loads semantic segmentation results.

- **`PolygonZone`** counts entries and exits per class and reports dwell time for every tracked object.
- **`Detections.from_semantic_segmentation`** turns a class map into one masked detection per class; Ultralytics and Inference results load too.
- **`KeyPointsDataset`** reads and writes YOLO pose datasets.
- **`box_weighted_box_fusion`** merges overlapping boxes from several models instead of throwing most of them away.
- **`VertexAnnotator`** and its siblings take a color palette and can color each joint by its index.

Most projects can upgrade as is, but the public `validate_*` helpers, `merge_inner_*` and `KeyPoints.confidence` are gone and a few edge cases changed, so check the Migration guide.

## ✨ Spotlights / highlights

### Zones that count entries, exits and dwell time

`sv.PolygonZone` now follows each `tracker_id` across frames. It counts objects entering and leaving (`in_count`, `out_count` and the per-class versions are named the same as on `sv.LineZone`), reports the current count per class, and measures how long each tracked object has been inside with `time_in_zone`. Pass a `timestamp` to `trigger` for seconds, or leave it out for frames. `occupancy_ratio` reports how much of the zone the detections cover, and `sv.PolygonZoneAnnotator` and `sv.LineZoneAnnotator` accept a `coord_transform` to draw at camera-mapped positions. (#2770, #1667, #2760)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/450b5c15-ae96-4990-93aa-28484b8c49cd

```python
import numpy as np
import supervision as sv

zone = sv.PolygonZone(polygon=np.array([[0, 0], [100, 0], [100, 100], [0, 100]]))

# A car drives in from the left, stays a while, then leaves on the right.
for frame, cx in enumerate([-10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 130]):
    car = sv.Detections(
        xyxy=np.array([[cx - 10, 40.0, cx + 10, 60.0]]),
        tracker_id=np.array([1]),
        class_id=np.array([0]),
    )
    zone.trigger(car, timestamp=frame * 0.5)
    if frame == 4:
        zone.time_in_zone(car)  # array([1.5]) seconds inside so far

zone.in_count, zone.out_count  # (1, 1)
zone.in_count_per_class  # {0: 1}
```

release.summary_zh:
Stirling Office Convert 现已取代我们 docker 容器中的 Libreoffice！ 
随着速度的提高和更好的质量转换，这也意味着我们的码头工人的尺寸将减半！  感谢所有向我们发送示例文件的人，请k
release.raw_body:
Stirling Office Convert has now replaced Libreoffice in our docker containers! 
Along with speed increases and better quality conversions it also means our docker going to half the size!  Thank you to everyone who sent us example files, and please keep reporting any conversions that don't look right! We are hoping to get this perfect!

We have also made a big fix for desktop users whose documents were reloading a few seconds after upload, Thank you to everyone who reported this and great to see people using the new feedback button! (In bottom right) 

With the Office Convert change (outside of the tools getting the toggle removed)
- Compress now uses Office Convert
- HTML to PDF supports zoom again
- New admin setting to cap how many Office conversions run at once and queue
- Damaged Office, ebook and HTML files now give a clear "could not be read" message instead of an error

Other changes are:
- Faster desktop PDF operations, with the PDF engine now pre-installed in the app
- Performance improvements across the viewer, file list etc
- JPDFium and other dependency updates causing various bug fixes and improvements 

We also fixed some bugs including:
- Desktop documents reloading themselves and losing progress shortly after being opened
- Filled form fields showing their value twice in the viewer
- Form values being invisible in dark mode
- Thumbnail sidebar getting stuck on "Loading..." after applying changes

Note (breaking changes):
- PDF to .doc (Word 97-2003) output has been removed. Use docx or odt instead; API calls, pipelines and automations asking for `doc` will now return an error
- .wpd, .wps, .lwp, .abw, .hwp and .xps files are no longer accepted for conversion
- `groupsToRemove` entries for removed tools (LibreOffice, Calibre, Weasyprint, OpenCV, etc.) no longer disable anything. 

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes
* fix(frontend): silence dev proxy ECONNREFUSED spam by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8853
* fix(ui): align add-password advanced dropdown to be more consistent with the rest of the UI by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8760
### Enhancements
* Support accessibility tagging of formulas in Text Editor by @EthanHealy01 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8945
* Send self-hosted Enterprise buyers to the hosted Enterprise page

release.raw_body:
Run the new Inkling 2 Mini model, the strongest 26.4B model that runs on 16GB RAM.
This release makes image generation faster and lighter on small GPUs. Macs with Apple Silicon can now restyle videos, and chats that use MCP tools no longer reprocess the whole conversation on every message.

## Highlights

- **Inkling 2 Mini** - less memory usage and faster. New 26B (5.4 active) 1M context - [Guide](https://unsloth.ai/docs/models/inkling-2-mini)
- **MiniMax-H3-Image on 8GB GPUs** renders a new prompt in 36.7 s (prev 82.7 s)
- **GGUF image models load with 52-66% less RAM** on Linux and macOS
- **Video Restyle on Mac** re-renders a whole clip in a new style on Apple
- **MCP chats process 83 to 87% fewer prompt tokens** in our tool tests
- **Scanned PDFs in chat** are now read with OCR
- **Theme files** let you share your Appearance settings

## Images

- FLUX.1 takes 16 to 28% less time per step when its weights stream from system RAM.
- FLUX.3 klein INT8 takes 13% less time per step on T4 GPUs.
- GTX 16xx cards no longer fail image renders with a NaN error.
- Picking a new LoRA on an INT8 or FP8 model offers **Reload and generate** instead of an error.

## Video

- Cosmos3-Edge-FP8 runs about 1.45x faster on L4 GPUs.
- Restyle on Mac needs about 42 GiB of GPU memory for bf16, or 31 GiB for q8_0.

## Diffusion LoRA training

- SDXL LoRA training takes 28 to 31% less time per step on T4 and L4.
- **Auto** precision trains FLUX.2-klein 9B in about 30% less time per step on L4.
- MiniMax-H3 re-runs reuse your encoded dataset.

## Chat + MCP

- A chat keeps its MCP tool list fixed, so each message only processes what is new.
- **Tool output length** in **Settings > Chat** now applies to MCP results on llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama and Custom connections.
- Attached Word files no longer lose moved paragraphs, date fields or furigana text.
- Imported Claude Code and Codex chats keep their images.
- A reasoning model that runs out of tokens while thinking now shows advice and **Retry**.

## Desktop + Mac

- Export or import themes in **Settings > Appearance > Theme file**.
- Unsloth Desktop no longer gets stuck on an incomplete install on some Windows AMD PCs.
- Macs with a chat-only GGUF install no longer show small models as "Does not fit".
- A lost reply during a session refresh no longer signs you out of every tab.

## Training

- AsyncGRPO steps are 1.46x to 2.47x faster on A100 with TRL 1.17 or newer.

release.raw_body:
## Release v2.3.5

From PR #23632: https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/pull/23632

### Summary

Contribution source: AI-assisted

Backport the cyan, green and red agent cover colors from [#23624](https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/pull/23624) to the community release branch. A fresh install of `main` can resolve `@lobehub/ui@6.19.0` within the declared dependency range. The old seven-entry palette fails type-checking on that version and returns an undefined cover color for some generated avatars.

The cover uses the corresponding theme token for each new color. Inferring the lookup's keys also supports older UI versions in the release's existing dependency range.

Also backports the canary test for the transaction-scoped share upload lock. Its query now counts the advisory lock for the share under test, allowing unrelated sessions to hold their own locks concurrently.

### Tests

- [x] Added a regression test using the UI library's actual avatar generator. On the original release, a green avatar received `undefined` where the theme specifies `var(--lobe-green)`.
- [x] Ran lint and the 10 related cover-color tests.
- [x] Ran the same standalone workspace compatibility check against the original release and this commit with UI 6.19.0. The original failed type-checking with `TS2739`; the fix passed type-checking and all 505 workspace tests.
- [x] Ran the repository type-check.
- [x] Held two unrelated advisory locks on a separate connection in a dedicated PostgreSQL instance. The old test saw three locks and failed. With the backport, all 60 agent-share tests passed while the two unrelated locks remained held. The repository lint and related tests also passed.

### Acceptance

Verified the real `/agents` page against the release base and this commit with UI 6.19.0. On the base, generated cyan, green and red avatars all had the same neutral card background. With the fix, each card has its corresponding theme color. The purple control kept the same background across both builds. [Browser captures and computed styles](https://app.lobehub.com/acceptance/478a1cff-663d-4820-a3fa-cba5a5a79a0a) (testing account access may be required).

### Desktop release baseline

Inherits the delivered sources from [v2.3.4](https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/releases/tag/v2.3.4).

1. **[对话体验]** 修复免登录分享对话中的全局变量、交互表单使用模型选择器时，未携带分享鉴权信息，导致模型列表或已选模型名称加载失败的问题。

3. **[对话体验]** 修复免登录分享对话中删除消息、重试及编辑后发送失败的问题。
4. **[列表体验]** 修复部分列表在内容缩短后无法继续滚动加载、分页失败后仍自动重复请求的问题。
5. **[账号与团队]** 修复联系方式弹窗关闭按钮因正文滚动而偏移或被裁剪的问题。

7. **[Agent]** 修复部分工作流工具在编辑器中配置正常，但运行时被错误过滤、无法调用的问题。

New Features

release.summary_zh:
- **Go 1.27.4** 构建每个 Quivr 二进制文件和图像（GO-2026-6859，在 `net/http` 中）。
- **PostgreSQL 17.12** 替换数据库映像中的 17.11。它附带 zlib 1.4 (CVE-2026-4738)。这是 PostgreSQL 的次要版本：磁盘上的数据保持原样。

release.raw_body:
## Quivr 2.0.3

2.0.3 is a security and fix release. It changes no API, no configuration and no stored data. Upgrade any 2.0.x installation to it.

### Security fixes

- **Go 1.27.4** builds every Quivr binary and image (GO-2026-6859, in `net/http`).
- **PostgreSQL 17.12** replaces 17.11 in the database image. It ships zlib 1.4 (CVE-2026-4738). This is a PostgreSQL minor release: the data on disk stays as it is.
- **SeaweedFS**, which stores original files, gets zlib 1.4 (CVE-2026-4738) and brotli v1.2.7 (GO-2026-6888).

### Fixed

- **Forms in the demo work over plain HTTP.**
  - **Before:** on an address other than HTTPS or localhost, adding a source, adding a text, creating an alert or editing a connector failed with « crypto.randomUUID is not a function ». Browsers offer that function only on secure pages.
  - **Now:** the demo makes its keys another way when the browser lacks it.
- **The demo's alerts use the alerts plugin version Quivr ships.** Before, a deployment with no setting asked for an older version, and the engine refused every alert as « not installed ».

### Upgrade from 2.0.x

Deploy the 2.0.3 images, or the 2.0.3 compose bundle attached to this release for a single machine. Restarting the database container on PostgreSQL 17.12 needs no dump or migration. The search database and Quivr's data stay as they are.

The release images are signed and carry SBOMs, as described in [Security of Quivr releases](https://docs.quivr.thevibecompany.co/run-quivr/security).

---

## [2.0.3](https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/quivr/compare/v2.0.2...v2.0.3) (2026-11-16)


### Bug Fixes

* **demo:** make idempotency keys without crypto.randomUUID over plain HTTP ([#3991](https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/quivr/issues/3991)) ([890b968](https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/quivr/commit/890b9689ca5a8b8a422be7017aa29522a259fe5f))
* **demo:** pin alerts to the plugin version the core serves ([#3980](https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/quivr/issues/3980)) ([25e4edf](https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/quivr/commit/25e4edf083c0fcd115ee952a048444de646604fd))
* **images:** build on Go 1.27.4 and patch zlib and brotli in Postgres and SeaweedFS ([#3992](https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/quivr/issues/3992)) ([b29e919](https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/quivr/commit/b29e91957dfa9f12720478f344f628ea922d0101))

- **更快开始。** 注册步骤更少（不再需要输入两次密码），注册和登录页面立即显示，并且设置不再卡在“正在加载您的设置...”上。注册 Google，您可以在同一步骤中连接 Gmail、云端硬盘和日历。 （#16829、#16831、#16968、#16845、#16877）
- **更安全的登录。** 添加新的帐户登录方式（Google、Microsoft、GitHub 或 Discord）现在需要从收件箱中获取六位数代码，除非该提供商运行您的邮箱（通过 Google 提供 Gmail，通过 Microsoft 提供 Outlook.com）。每当添加新的登录方法时，您也会收到一封电子邮件。 (#16860)

release.raw_body:
## ⚠️ Breaking change

**The frontend no longer reads `TRUST_X_FORWARDED_FOR`** (#16530, @Pwuts). A self-hosted frontend that set it by hand gets no client IP from `X-Forwarded-For` for the sign-in IP log, IP blocks and per-visitor store search until `TRUSTED_PROXIES` lists the proxy in front of it. The single-container image and Vercel need nothing.

**What to do:** if your frontend sets `TRUST_X_FORWARDED_FOR`, remove it and set `TRUSTED_PROXIES` to a comma-separated list of the addresses or CIDR ranges of the proxies in front of it. Until you do, the frontend logs a warning at start that the old setting is ignored. The same `TRUSTED_PROXIES` setting now also names the proxies for the backend and the External API's per-address limits, replacing `FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS` and `TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT`, which keep working but are deprecated; behind your own reverse proxy, the single-container image takes it too. See [Client IP Addresses](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT/blob/master/docs/platform/client-ip.md).

---

## ✨ Highlights

- **Get started faster.** Signing up takes fewer steps (no more typing your password twice), the sign-up and login pages show up right away, and setup no longer gets stuck on "Loading your setup…". Sign up with Google and you can connect Gmail, Drive and Calendar in the same step. (#16829, #16831, #16968, #16845, #16877)
- **Safer sign-ins.** Adding a new way to sign in to your account (Google, Microsoft, GitHub or Discord) now takes a six-digit code from your inbox, unless that provider runs your mailbox (Gmail through Google, Outlook.com through Microsoft). You also get an email whenever a new sign-in method is added. (#16860)
- **Never lose a message.** If Otto can't confirm your message arrived, one click on Send again delivers it, files included, without sending it twice. And "Thinking…" now stays up until Otto starts answering, so you always know it's working. (#17041, #16962, #17038)
- **Always see where your runs really are.** After a brief connection drop, your Library, run history, Activity and chats catch up on their own, so a run that already finished no longer looks like it's still going. Live updates also keep flowing on slow connections. (#16898, #16915, #16932, #16903, #16865, #16960)
