release.raw_body:
This release distinguishes network failures from genuinely empty states, enforces strict polling session isolation, and delivers noticeable performance gains across interactions.

### Fixed

- **Failure states separated from empty results**: Previously, network errors in comments, search, and collection feeds rendered misleading empty states ("No comments yet", "Prompt not found"). This update properly separates errors from empty data:
  - Network errors now surface a dedicated "Retry" action that bypasses the 60-minute cache suppression window.
  - Temporary network blips no longer falsely report prompts as deleted or inject incorrect `noindex` directives.
- **Session-scoped polling guards**: Switches between prompts immediately invalidate stale polling workers, preventing out-of-order responses from writing into newly opened cards.
- **Auth flow consistency**: Visiting community details or performing protected actions while logged out now opens the login modal directly rather than showing transient toasts.

### Added & Improved

- **Visibility badges & placeholder highlights**: Public prompts now feature a globe icon and clear visibility tooltips; bracketed `[placeholders]` are visually highlighted with replacement tips below the Copy button.
- **Performance optimizations (INP & LCP)**: Modals are preloaded during browser idle intervals and pointer events to eliminate chunk-loading delays (improved INP); offscreen community cards apply `content-visibility: auto` (improved LCP).
- **Localization**: Synced retry actions and share-state labels across all 17 supported locales.

---

## 中文

这一版彻底区分了网络错误与空内容状态，修复了多场景下的轮询与会话隔离，并带来了显著的渲染与交互性能提升。

### 核心修复

- **网络失败态与空数据分离**：评论区、社区列表、社区详情、首页搜索与我的收藏此前在请求失败时均会错误渲染成空状态（如「暂无评论」「提示词未找到」「暂无内容」）。新版彻底区分了异常与空数据：
  - 网络错误时提供明确的「重试」入口，点击时强制绕过 60 分钟限流窗口发起真实请求。
  - 避免因临时网络抖动将正常提示词误判为已被删除，防止异常态注入错误的 `noindex` 元标签。
- **轮询防串与身份守卫**：切换提示词时旧轮询任务立即废弃作废，防止复用页面实例时旧轮询的迟到响应污染新提示词页面。
- **登录交互与权限判定**：未登录状态下点击社区详情或进行操作时，直接弹出登录框而非仅提示浅层 Toast；修复未登录投票时的重复提示。

### 新增与优化

- **卡片公开状态标识**：公开提示词卡片新增地球图标与状态 Tooltip，清晰说明可见范围；提示词正文中的 `[占位符]` 增加高亮样式，并在复制按钮下方补充替换指引。
- **性能优化（Core Web Vitals）**：详情弹窗通过空闲时段与鼠标移入预加载，大幅消除打开弹窗时的卡顿（优化 INP）；离屏提示词卡片启用 `content-visibility: auto`，大幅提升首屏加载性能（优化 LCP）。
- **多语言完善**：同步补齐 17 种语言下的重试、公开状态及失败提示文案。

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rockbenben/ChatGPT-Shortcut/compare/v4.5.1...v4.5.2

release.summary_zh:
- **新相机：** Canon、Z CAM、HOVERAir、XTRA 等，见下文
- **光学稳定** - 新的稳定算法无需运动数据，实际上很好。它在大多数具有良好跟踪点和良好镜头轮廓的视频上产生与基于陀螺仪的稳定相似的结果。在“运动数据 -> 光学校正”中启用。这修复了所有 O4 问题、振动、陀螺仪不良、O4 Lite、DJI Neo 震动、FPV 上的 Hero 7、使用 RockSteady 的 DJI、使用 OSS 的索尼等。如果帧中有移动的主体，您可以编辑每个跟踪点并将其从解决方案中删除。需要有效的镜头配置文件。
- **新的“最佳路径”平滑** - 立即规划整个剪辑的相机路径：它在相同变焦下比“默认”消除更多的抖动，永远不会落后于平移，并将帧保持在变焦限制内。在“稳定”面板中选择它并尝试您的镜头 - 它与默认的感觉完全不同。
release.raw_body:
### ✨ Improvements
- **New cameras:** Canon, Z CAM, HOVERAir, XTRA and more, see below
- **Optical stabilization** - New algorithm for stabilization without motion data that's actually good. It produces similar results to gyro-based stabilization on most videos with good tracking points and good lens profile. Enable in `Motion data -> Optical correction`. This fixes all O4 issues, vibrations, bad gyro, O4 Lite, DJI Neo shakes, Hero 7 on FPV, DJI with RockSteady, Sony with OSS etc. If you have a moving subject in frame, you can edit every tracked point and remove it from the solution. Valid lens profile is required.
- **New "Optimal path" smoothing** - plans the camera path for the whole clip at once: it removes much more shake than "Default" at the same zoom, never lags behind pans, and keeps the frame within the zoom limit. Select it in the "Stabilization" panel and try on your footage - it has a completely different feel than Default.
- **GoPro now uses official calibrations** - Lens profiles are more acurate and all new GoPro models are supported without changes to Gyroflow
- **All [Sony issues](https://github.com/gyroflow/gyroflow/issues/849) have been fixed**, including Dynamic Active support
- **Sony lens breathing compensation**, using the data recorded by the supported lenses
- **RED gyro data is now accurately timed**, autosync is no longer needed
- **Focal length stabilization** - smooths out fast zooms and zoom "pumping" by cropping. Works with every file that records the focal length (Sony, Canon, Blackmagic, RED, Nikon, Z CAM). Enable in the "Stabilization" panel (by @Milchgsicht-star)
- **Manual zoom level for "Static zoom"** - every video is zoomed by exactly the amount you set, like in-camera stabilization, and smoothing is lowered only where the frame doesn't fit (by @anton-belkin)
- **New horizon lock options:** "Lock pitch angle" (by @Ivan1248) and "Automatic lock", which lets the horizon lean into banked turns (by @mihatsu)
- **Reworked lens math:** "Lens correction" below 100% is now exact and changes the image evenly, underwater refraction is exact across the whole frame, and Gyroflow now supports lenses wider than 180°
- **Added "Output projection"** (stereographic, equidistant, equisolid, orthographic) to show the whole picture of very wide lenses like Insta360 X4/X5 or fisheye adapters
- **Videos open faster**, and play unstabilized while the motion data loads (by @TimoLehnertz)

release.raw_body:
以 Caddy 发行版 v2.11.9 源码加插件 forwardproxy、caddy-trojan、caddy-webdav、caddy-cloudflare-ip、caddy-trusted-cloudfront、caddy-dns/cloudflare、caddy-dns/duckdns、caddy-dns/tencentcloud、caddy-events-exec、caddy-l4、jsonc-adapter 基于稳定版 go1.27.3 定制编译而成，其额外应用及特点如下：
1、支持 NaiveProxy 应用（服务端）。采用 ZihaoFU245 大源码，支持 UoT。
2、支持 Trojan-Go 应用（服务端）。
3、支持 WebDAV 协议的网盘应用（服务端）。
4、支持启用可信任 Cloudflare IPs，可实现使用 Cloudflare CDN 后也能获取到客户端真实 IP。
5、支持启用可信任 Cloudfront IPs，可实现使用 Cloudfront CDN 后也能获取到客户端真实 IP。
6、支持由 Cloudflare 解析的域名以 DNS-01 验证方式申请及更新 TLS 证书、支持由 Cloudflare 解析的域名可 ECH 发布。
7、支持由 DuckDNS 解析的域名以 DNS-01 验证方式申请及更新 TLS 证书。
8、支持由 TencentCloud 解析的域名以 DNS-01 验证方式申请及更新 TLS 证书。
9、支持事件执行应用，可解决相关程序不支持‘证书热更新’问题。
10、支持 Caddy 的第 4 层（TCP/UDP）应用，可实现 SNI 分流共用 TCP/UDP 端口（含定向 UDP 转发）。SNI 分流共用 TCP 端口时支持 PROXY protocol 发送，即发送真实来源 IP 和端口给后端。
11、支持 Caddy 可使用 JSONC 格式配置文件（即可保留注释使用）。​

注意：如果版本小于 v2.10.2 升级，请参阅如下 v2.10.2 相关提示。

### Major updates

- RDP: open RDP bookmarks with the local Windows client (mstsc.exe) via a per-bookmark switch, for old or non-standard servers the built-in client cannot reach (#4420) (#4761) by @H-TWINKLE

### New features/UI/Updates

- Reload a stopped terminal with Enter (#4773)
- Add direct bookmark edit to the tab context menu (#4755)
- Bind Cmd+, to the settings item on macOS (#4760) by @pcbeingused333
- Localize widget metadata from the widget's own repo (#4745)
- Clarify the widget install warning (#4749)

### Bug fixes

- Security: keep Markdown links out of the app window (#4763)
- Security: keep the main window on the app origin (#4762)
- Security: harden built-in FTP server widget defaults
- Harden static file server widget against DNS rebinding
- Propagate ZMODEM disk backpressure to terminal transports (#4772)
- Fix trzsz transfer framing, file handling and cancellation (#4771)
- Fix ZMODEM download completion, backpressure and split detection (#4770)
- Keep the extension for duplicate ZMODEM downloads (#4750)
- Stop a right click electerm handles from also reaching the program
- Report an empty OpenAI chat message as an error (#4754) by @pcbeingused333
- Fix MCP SFTP upload destinations and conflict handling (#4753) by @cccy0

-----

### 重大更新

- RDP：支持通过书签设置使用 Windows 本地远程桌面客户端 (mstsc.exe) 打开 RDP 书签，可连接内置客户端无法访问的旧版或非标准服务器 (#4420) (#4761)（由 @H-TWINKLE 提供）

### 新功能/界面/更新

- 按回车键重新加载已停止的终端 (#4773)
- 标签页右键菜单支持直接编辑书签 (#4755)
- macOS 菜单支持用 Cmd+, 打开设置 (#4760)（由 @pcbeingused333 提供）
- 小组件元数据从小组件自己的仓库获取本地化文案 (#4745)
- 明确小组件安装警告文案 (#4749)

### 问题修复

- 安全：阻止 Markdown 链接在应用窗口内打开 (#4763)
- 安全：主窗口限制在应用来源内 (#4762)
- 安全：加固内置 FTP 服务器小组件的默认设置
- 加固静态文件服务器小组件，防范 DNS rebinding 攻击
- 修复 ZMODEM：将磁盘背压传递到终端传输层 (#4772)
- 修复 trzsz 传输的分帧、文件处理和取消逻辑 (#4771)

* Finally work around that [stupid AMI NTFS driver bug](https://github.com/pbatard/AmiNtfsBug), so that runtime UEFI media validation can work on the millions of PCs that AMI screwed up
* Finally report USB 3.2+ devices (USB 3.2 = 20 Gbps, USB 4.0 = 40 Gpbs, USB 4.1 = 80 Gbps — See, USB Forum, it's really NOT that hard!)
* Fix the CA 2023 updated files not being taken into account during runtime UEFI media validation
* Fix the "Silent" installation option being potentially applied even when all dependencies aren't met (#3008)
* Fix a regression where "Write as ESP" used the whole drive, instead of the expected 1 GB partition
* Fix WUE timezone duplication for non English locales (#3070, #2499) and reinstate the use of dots in local usernames (#3057)
* Add classic right click context menu restoration to the QoL improvements option (courtesy of @Fredolx , #3007)
* Drop the ever problematic use of Group Policies when disabling the _"Do you want to format this drive?"_ prompt (#3042)
* Improve raw image partition (re)mount (courtesy of @jaredhagel2, #3002)
* Update embedded [GRUB](https://gitlab.com/gnu_grub/grub) to version 2.16
* Update [libcdio](https://github.com/libcdio/libcdio-C) to latest
* Update the official UEFI DBX URLs, since they were changed by Microsoft
* Address multiple vulnerabilities, courtesy of @indep-arg, @andife, Adam Korczynski, @SilentSobs and @kasparovabi: 
  - GHSA-hhx4-pjqh-499x, GHSA-hrxr-p5wv-qxm2, GHSA-6xgr-6q48-jwxr, GHSA-xh22-8phc-hw8j, GHSA-877g-r8h5-fq8p, GHSA-hcpc-vq8c-923h, GHSA-w4w7-p3x2-3p83, GHSA-j6fh-hww6-74mw, GHSA-xx6m-qq8h-8882
  - #3033, #3022
  - ANT-2026-QQV5VRY4, ANT-2026-A0JKMSB0, ANT-2026-85N3B2M9, ANT-2026-3CMBZ6X6, ANT-2026-1FCTXF5S, ANT-2026-0J6W5VHP
  - It should be noted that **all** the vulnerabilities above either require an already compromised system (for local to elevated exploitation), or a malicious ISO, or a MITM/domain/GitHub compromise, in which case you are most likely already p0wned, as an attacker should avail of **much** better paths of exploitation than a Rufus exploit.

release.raw_body:
- Switched [ACL](https://hysteria.network/docs/advanced/ACL/) to a new engine based on [expr](https://expr-lang.org/)
    - Rules are now expressions, set with `acl.rules` or `acl.rulesFile`. Besides the destination and protocol, they can match on the client's authentication ID and address, e.g. to route each user through a different outbound
    - Added `hysteria acl test` to [check which rule and outbound a request would use](https://hysteria.network/docs/advanced/ACL/#testing-rules)
    - The [legacy syntax](https://hysteria.network/docs/advanced/ACL/#legacy-syntax) (`acl.file` and `acl.inline`) still works. Legacy rules can be [mixed into `acl.rules`](https://hysteria.network/docs/advanced/ACL/#mixing-legacy-rules-into-rules), or converted with [`hysteria acl translate`](https://hysteria.network/docs/advanced/ACL/#converting-legacy-rules)
    - Fixed legacy port ranges starting at 0 (e.g. `udp/0-100`) matching every port
- Improved UDP forwarding performance by reducing per-packet overhead (about 30% more packets per second for small-packet upload)
- Updated quic-go to v0.65.0

---

- [ACL](https://hysteria.network/zh/docs/advanced/ACL/) 改用基于 [expr](https://expr-lang.org/) 的全新引擎
    - 规则现在以表达式的形式编写，通过 `acl.rules` 或 `acl.rulesFile` 设置。除目标地址和协议外，还可以根据客户端的验证 ID 和地址进行匹配，例如让不同用户走不同出站
    - 新增 `hysteria acl test`，用于[测试某个请求会使用哪条规则和哪个出站](https://hysteria.network/zh/docs/advanced/ACL/#testing-rules)
    - [旧版语法](https://hysteria.network/zh/docs/advanced/ACL/#legacy-syntax)（`acl.file` 和 `acl.inline`）仍然可以使用。旧版规则可以[混用在 `acl.rules` 中](https://hysteria.network/zh/docs/advanced/ACL/#mixing-legacy-rules-into-rules)，也可以用 [`hysteria acl translate`](https://hysteria.network/zh/docs/advanced/ACL/#converting-legacy-rules) 转换
    - 修复旧版语法中从 0 开始的端口范围（例如 `udp/0-100`）会匹配所有端口的 bug
- 优化 UDP 转发的处理开销，提升性能（小包上传提升约 30%）

release.raw_body:
# Motrix 2.4.5

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/main/docs/release-notes/2.4.5.zh-CN.md)

## Changes since 2.4.4

- Desktop now accepts recoverable handoffs from paired browser extensions by default. Browser Extension **0.1.25** negotiates this capability for eligible paused downloads. If the connection drops after submission, the extension can recover the existing task ID.
- Existing extensions and older hosts continue to support the original download submission method. To stop accepting new handoffs on Desktop, launch with `MOTRIX_DOWNLOAD_HANDOFF=0`; previously prepared operations can still finish.

## Upgrade compatibility

**Back up your profile and download files before upgrading.** The bundled engine
uses SQLite **schema 6**. When upgrading an older engine database, retain its
complete pre-upgrade backup; older engines cannot open schema 6. Stop all engines
before restoring a verified backup to a separate path for a downgrade. Do not
reset or delete the upgraded database as a substitute for recovery.

Users migrating from Motrix v1 should follow the
[migration guide](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.4.5/docs/legacy-migration.md)
and retain the original profile and engine database backups.

## Downloads and updates

Desktop packages support macOS 13 or later, Windows 10 or later, and Linux, with
native x64 and ARM64 builds. No 32-bit desktop packages are provided. Official
macOS packages require signing and notarization. Windows NSIS installers and ZIP
archives are unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen; use official Release downloads.

Stable publication updates both `latest*.yml` and `beta*.yml` feeds to 2.4.5.
Flatpak bundles and Native Host companions remain separate downloads. Snap
availability requires verified Store publication to edge and promotion of the
same amd64/arm64 revisions through candidate to stable.

Server images use `docker.io/motrixapp/motrix-server:2.4.5` and
`ghcr.io/agalwood/motrix-server:2.4.5`. After public multi-platform runtime
verification, `2.4`, `2`, `stable`, and `latest` advance to the same verified digest.
See the [Docker Server guide](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.4.5/docs/docker-server.md).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/compare/v2.4.4...v2.4.5)


## What's Changed
* feat(release): enable paired desktop handoff by default in 2.4.5 by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2539


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/c

![0 5 5](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3890945/105014988-575cb680-5a41-11eb-90d5-d942d28184b2.png)

发行说明

Sandboxie-Plus 1.19.1 在 SandMan 中引入了人工智能辅助故障排除。新的“使用 AI 代理进行故障排除”工具库
release.raw_body: ![0 5 5](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3890945/105014988-575cb680-5a41-11eb-90d5-d942d28184b2.png) ### Release Notes Sandboxie-Plus 1.19.1 introduces AI-assisted troubleshooting in SandMan. The new “Troubleshoot with an AI Agent” toolbar button lets you connect an MCP-compatible AI client to investigate a sandbox issue. The feature is off by default and uses a local named pipe with a one-time pairing code. SandMan shows you the exact configuration changes or commands the agent proposes and asks for approval each time. You can review the session history and choose whether to submit an issue report with the agent’s findings and a log of the actions taken. This release fixes two performance problems. Sandboxed applications that frequently look up localized strings or resources could suffer severe slowdowns, including frame rate drops in games. Those lookups now benefit from Windows’ cached language settings again. Sandboxie also removes a configuration locking bottleneck that forced concurrent process launches to wait on one another. Sandbox border labels can now appear on any of the four window edges. A dedicated Box Border tab lets you choose the font, position and text orientation. The built-in INI editors gain optional line numbers and Ctrl+G navigation, and the new CustomProcessCommandLine setting lets you conditionally add, remove or replace arguments when launching a sandboxed process. Version 1.19.1 also restores Windows 7 compatibility after a regression in 1.19.0 and fixes a hang when elevating sandboxed programs with Windows Administrator Protection enabled. Several SandMan crashes during startup, sandbox creation and shutdown have been fixed. The message log now has a size limit to prevent memory exhaustion during long sessions. For a full list of changes please review the [change log](https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#1191--5741---2026-10-21). #### You can support the project through donations, any help will be greatly appreciated. [](https://xanasoft.com/go.php?to=donate) #### If you have issues with an update installation, just uninstall the previous version keeping the sandboxie.ini and reinstall the new build.

## :mega: 获取其他软件包 / How to Get Other Packages

### 方式 1：添加软件源 / Method 1: Add Software Source
 * 请按照 [openwrt-passwall-build](https://github.com/moetayuko/openwrt-passwall-build) 仓库的说明，将其提供的软件源添加到设备中，然后直接使用包管理器安装。
  Follow the instructions in the [openwrt-passwall-build](https://github.com/moetayuko/openwrt-passwall-build) repository to add the provided software source to your device, then install directly using the package manager.

### 方式 2：手动下载并安装 / Method 2: Manual Download and Install

* 从 [SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/files/) 下载预构建的软件包。
  Download prebuilt packages from [SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/files/).

* 将文件上传到您的设备，使用 Shell 命令进行安装。
  Upload files to your device, install it with shell command.

ipk
```
opkg install /path/to/package.ipk
```
apk
```
apk add --allow-untrusted /path/to/package.apk
```

:warning: 请将 /path/to/package 替换为实际下载的软件包路径。
- Replace /path/to/package with the actual path of the downloaded packages.

---
## :rocket: 配套固件与工具 / Firmwares & Tools

### :fire: [OpenWrtAction](https://github.com/smallprogram/OpenWrtAction) —— 集成 Passwall 的 CI 固件 / Ready-to-use firmware with Passwall
* 集成官方 OpenWrt 25.12、ImmortalWrt 25.12、Lean (Snapshot) 固件，支持 x86、R2S、R2C、R4S、R5S、R5C、H66K、H68K、H69K、R66S、R68S 等设备，刷入即用。
  Firmware built on official OpenWrt 25.12, ImmortalWrt 25.12 and Lean (Snapshot), supporting x86, R2S, R2C, R4S, R5S, R5C, H66K, H68K, H69K, R66S, R68S and more.
* 支持 GitHub 一键更新：直接从 GitHub Releases 在线升级固件，无需手动下载和刷写。
  Supports one-click GitHub update: upgrade the firmware online straight from GitHub Releases, no manual download or flashing needed.

### :package: [Are-u-ok](https://github.com/bcseputetto/Are-u-ok) —— iStoreOS .run 更新包 / iStoreOS .run update packages
* 为 iStoreOS 提供 .run 格式更新包，无需重刷固件，上传执行即可安装/升级。
  Provides .run update packages for iStoreOS — no reflashing needed, just upload and run.
